title: Data Director, Growth and Marketing
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍 London, Cardiff or UK Remote | 💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options & benefits | ✅ Visa sponsorship & relocation available

About our Data Discipline

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.

Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.

Our Growth and Marketing Analytics team ⭐

We’re looking for a Data Director to join our Growth and Marketing Collective here at Monzo. Our goal in Growth and Marketing is to build Monzo into a global brand people love. We're the team that finds exciting new ways to bring customers to Monzo and keep them engaged once they join. We create the features and cool stuff that gets everyone talking about us. We also figure out the best ways to communicate with our customers. Data is a driving force in everything we do, and this role will lead the team making sure our Growth and Marketing folks can easily use data to inform their every day decisions.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

On day one, you'll develop and nurture a diverse data team to make smart marketing and product driven growth investments. You’ll work closely with the Growth and Marketing collective leadership team to set the overall direction and work with your team to craft the insights, data products, and intelligent systems to realise those ambitions. You’ll help us with the following questions and challenges:

  • Define our global marketing strategy as well as our product growth one
  • How to balance growing different markets and customer segments
  • Advance our measurement precisions to grow our confidence in where to best invest next
  • Balancing marketing with product driven growth
  • Deeply understand network effects and the role they play

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re excited about what we’re doing at Monzo and have experience leading Data teams at Director level or above.
  • You’re an empathetic, inclusive leader who has hired, developed and retained high-performing Data teams, including individual contributors and managers.
  • You have a hands-on Data Science background and can move comfortably between technical detail, commercial outcomes and customer strategy.
  • You have deep experience in marketing measurement, experimentation and choosing the right methods to guide investment and growth decisions.
  • You’ve led goal-setting across a company or division, defining clear metrics and targets in partnership with Finance.
  • You can turn complex business challenges into technical solutions and clear, actionable recommendations.
  • You build strong relationships across business areas and are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, including ExCo and C-level leaders.
  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and use data to challenge thinking, navigate trade-offs and improve how teams make decisions

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

  • 30 minute recruiter call
  • 60 minute call with the hiring manager
  • 4 x 1-hour video calls with various team members, including the General Manager for Growth & Marketing

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.

🙌 What’s in it for you...

💰 £150,900 to £204,100 ➕ plus stock options & benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK/Spain

✅ We can sponsor visas

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

#LI-JH1 #LI-Remote

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

title: Autonomous Systems Security Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote-Friendly (Travel Required) | San Francisco, CA

 About Anthropic

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 About the role

 Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. You'll be the engineer who owns autonomous systems across that footprint as one security domain, from both sides: drones, ground robots and automated vehicles for patrol, inspection and moving hardware, including the security of that automation inside secure areas, and the detection systems that tell us what is flying over or operating near a site uninvited.

 You set the approach, select and integrate the platforms and sensors, write the requirements vendors build to, and run what you ship, from the operating model where operators assign missions and machines carry them out to the playbook that turns a detection into an identified track and a well-evidenced handoff to whoever holds authority over the airspace. Interdiction is not part of this role. The goal is security that runs itself: coverage, fleet health and evidence verified continuously, with tools and AI agents doing the routine triage. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

 You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including its physical security systems engineers and the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's data center operations and legal teams, and directly with site operators, equipment vendors and aviation and public safety authorities. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

 Key responsibilities

•
 Autonomous security and inspection systems: own the drones, ground robots and other autonomous platforms for perimeter patrol, incident response and infrastructure inspection: platform selection, operating model, operator qualification, maintenance, and the data path from machine to analyst

•
 Tools, automation and AI agents: build the integrations that carry detections, tracks, telemetry and fleet health into the team's security monitoring platform, and the tools and agents that triage detections, check fleet health and assemble evidence. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it

•
 Detection of uncrewed systems: engineer the sensing that tells us what is flying over or operating near a site, what it is and who needs to know: sensor selection and evaluation against live targets, per-site coverage, classification and false-alarm handling, and the playbook from first detection to handoff, with evidence retained

•
 Security of site automation: engineer the controls on automated vehicles, robots and similar machines that move hardware or work inside secure areas: identity and access, network isolation, what they may record and where it goes, fail-secure behavior, their place in chain of custody, and acceptance before they enter a site

•
 Regulatory and site constraints: establish what we may sense, fly, drive, record and retain at each site, partner-operated sites included, under the aviation, spectrum, privacy and safety rules that apply there, with the waivers and approvals that extend it and coordination with local authorities set up before it is needed

•
 Health monitoring: define and test heartbeats, loss-of-coverage and lost-link alarms and fail-secure behavior, so a silent sensor or machine shows as a fault, not a quiet day

•
 Vendor requirements and acceptance: write the requirements, evaluate against live flights and runs, and hold vendors to what they ship

 Minimum qualifications

•
 Have engineered autonomous or sensing systems in the field (drones, ground robots, automated vehicles, or RF, radar or optical detection sensors): selected, integrated or secured them for an operation other people relied on, and verified what they actually do against real targets or runs rather than a datasheet

•
 Have integrated systems you did not build (vendor APIs, SDKs, appliances, machine and sensor telemetry) into a platform that outlives any one of them

•
 Read and review code, design the data systems behind security tooling, and build automation (often with AI coding agents) using Git and code review

•
 Have done this work hands-on for data centers, critical infrastructure or a large hardware fleet

•
 Have designed inside a regulatory or safety constraint (aviation, spectrum, privacy, machine safety or similar) and can show the decision it drove

•
 Own a domain end to end: set the approach, carry it through with vendors, site operators, partners and authorities, and run it as something people depend on every day

 Preferred qualifications

•
 Remote pilot certification (for example FAA Part 107) and experience flying beyond visual line of sight under a waiver or exemption

•
 Experience with counter-drone (counter-UAS) detection, airspace surveillance or air traffic data systems

•
 Experience running a robot, drone or automated-vehicle fleet in an industrial, logistics or data center setting: fleet management, mission planning, safety cases

•
 Experience securing embedded, operational technology or robotic systems: device identity, network segmentation, update control, logging

•
 Experience with physical security operations at large sites, with law enforcement or aviation authorities, or at sites you did not fully control: cloud, colocation or GPU cloud operators

•
 Have built AI agents or automation that replaced recurring manual work

 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

 Annual Salary:
 $320,000 — $405,000 USD

 Logistics

 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

 How we're different

 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

 Come work with us!

 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/anthropic-autonomous-systems-security-engineer

title: Early Years Teaching Assistant - Level 2
description:
Job Title: Early Years (Pre-school) Teaching Assistant – Level 2 

Actual Annual Salary:  £20,698 - £22,313 Based on hours and week worked 

Full Time Equivalent Salary: £29,812 - £32,138 (CLF Grade C) Based on full time hours, all year round. 

Contract Type: Permanent 

Hours: 30 hours per week - Full Time, Term Time Only plus Inset days  

Additional information: Monday to Friday (6 hours per day) 

Potential Start Date: January 2027 (Subject to completion of pre-employment checks) 

An opportunity to inspire curiosity, confidence and a love of learning by supporting children at the very start of their educational journey. 

We are seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic Early Years Teaching Assistant Level 2 to join the team at Haywood Village Academy. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about supporting young children to achieve important developmental milestones and thrive within a nurturing, inclusive and engaging Early Years environment. 

Working within our Early Years (pre-school) provision, you will play a key role in supporting the educational, personal, social and emotional development of children. Working alongside teachers and colleagues, you will help deliver high-quality learning experiences that enable every child to develop confidence, independence and a positive attitude towards learning. 

As part of a collaborative and supportive team, you will provide targeted support to individual children and small groups, adapting activities and strategies to meet a range of learning and developmental needs, including those of children with SEND and additional needs. Your specialist Early Years knowledge and experience will help children engage successfully with learning, reach developmental milestones and achieve their full potential. 

You will contribute to the monitoring, assessment and recording of children's progress, helping to inform future learning and targeted interventions. You will also work closely with parents, carers and other professionals, fostering positive relationships that support children's development, wellbeing and success. 

The role includes supporting the day-to-day operation of the Early Years setting, maintaining high standards of care, hygiene and safeguarding, and helping to create a safe, stimulating and inclusive environment where every child feels valued, supported and encouraged to flourish. 

About You 

We are looking for someone who: 

  • Holds an Early Years Educator Level 2/3 Diploma (or equivalent recognised Early Years qualification). 
  • Has experience working within an Early Years setting, supporting children's learning, development and wellbeing. 
  • Has a strong understanding of child development, the Early Years curriculum, safeguarding requirements and positive behaviour management strategies. 
  • Can effectively support learning through planned activities for individual children and small groups. 
  • Is able to monitor, record and report on children's progress, development and achievements. 
  • Demonstrates excellent communication and interpersonal skills, building positive relationships with children, parents, carers, colleagues and external agencies. 
  • Is committed to inclusion and can effectively support children with SEND and additional needs. 
  • Is patient, caring, resilient and able to remain calm and professional in challenging situations. 
  • Has strong organisational skills and can contribute to planning, preparing resources and maintaining accurate records. 
  • Holds GCSE English and Maths at Grade C/4 or above (or equivalent qualifications and/or experience). 
  • Is committed to safeguarding, equality, diversity and promoting the welfare of children and young people. 
  • Is committed to ongoing professional development and continuous improvement. 

This is an excellent opportunity to join Haywood Village Academy and become part of a team that is committed to ensuring every child receives the very best start to their educational journey. 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application.   

About Haywood Village Academy: 

We are very proud of our community school in Haywood Village, Weston-super-Mare. We currently have classes from Pre-school to Year 6.  

The academy is at the heart of the community that it serves and is defined by High Aspirations, Valuing Learning and Achievement for all. We have created a school where children flourish. The school offers a limitless education that empowers choice through enriching, meaningful and active opportunities. Staff receive high quality professional training and support and contribute positively to the development of the school.  

Why work at CLF?   

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others.   

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion.  

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered. 

What we can offer you: 

  • Access to a generous pension through the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS). 
  • Generous annual leave. 
  • A comprehensive induction and ongoing commitment to wellbeing and career progression, through a range of training, apprenticeships and in-role/wider-trust development opportunities. 
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme. 
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs. 
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay. 
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking plus many more! 

Recruitment timeline:   

  • Closing Date: 02 December 2026 @11.59pm 
  • Shortlisting date: 03 December 2026 
  • Interviews: Week commencing 07 December 2026 

We welcome visits from potential candidates. If you would like to arrange a school visit prior to the closing date, please contact the academy/site directly to arrange a suitable appointment.   

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form.    

Please note we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.   

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out.     

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are dedicated to equity and inclusion and commit to interviewing applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria. We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or require any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process please let us know how we can assist.

title: Deputy SENCo
description:
Job Title: Deputy SENCO 

Actual Annual Salary: £27,427 - £30,332 - based on hours worked  

Full-Time Annual Salary: £37,035 - £40,958 (Grade E) based on Full-Time hours 

Contract Type: Permanent, term time only plus insets  

Hours: 32 hours per week, Full time & Part time considered. 

Provisional start date: 4 January 27, – pending completion of pre-employment checks 

A chance to offer valuable support and guidance to a respected SEND team within a thriving and dynamic academy:  

We are looking for a Deputy SENCO to join our supportive and talented team at King’s Oak Academy. The CLF is a diverse multi-academy trust, looking for professional and ambitious people, with a passion for transforming our students’ learning.   

To be successful in the post, we are looking for a professional who will assist the SENCO in leading and managing the provision of special educational needs and disability (SEND) learning support for identified students in the Academy.  They will be responsible for the day-to-day operational running of the SEND team, maintaining the SEND register and the effective use of resources to support high standards of learning and achievement for all children in line with the SEND code of practice.    

The postholder will ensure the individual needs of designated students and the requirements of any statements are fully met.  They will deliver measurable impact on student attainment as well as personal and emotional development.  They will be required to deputise for the SENCO in their absence.  

You will have: 

  • An NVQ level 3 (or equivalent) in education and/or SEN (such as Learning and Development and Support Services for children, young people and those who care for them) or equivalent qualification/experience.   
  • An understanding of learning processes, barriers to learning and behaviour management strategies to facilitate delivering learning activities effectively.   
  • A clear understanding of children’s educational and emotional needs as their develop from Reception – Year 11. 
  • Proven experience of working effectively with SEND students, students with additional needs and/or disabilities on an individual basis or in groups.  
  • The ability to work constructively as part of a cohesive all-through team, understand classroom roles and responsibilities and own position within these  

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application. 

About King’s Oak Academy: 

King’s Oak Academy is situated in the heart of the South Gloucestershire community and is within easy commuting distance of Bristol and Bath. The academy has been part of the Cabot Learning Federation since 2011 and enjoys the benefits of being part of a mature, successful multi-academy trust, offering access to high-quality professional services and opportunities to work collaboratively with experienced colleagues across the trust.  

As an all-through school, King’s Oak is in a privileged position to educate children aged 4–16 and to support families over time. The academy has 228 children in Reception-Year 6 and 662 in Year 7-11. The school is structured into phases that ensures that learning is high quality and responsive to pupils’ developmental needs and long-term relationships are fostered with families. As a result, colleagues benefit from the distinctive professional development and leadership opportunities that come from working in an all-through community school.  

King’s Oak was inspected in June 2025 and secured an ‘Outstanding’ judgement in both Leadership and Management and Personal Development. Inspectors noted that “pupils thrive at King’s Oak Academy. The school expects them to ‘work hard, be kind’, and pupils strive to do this. There are high expectations of what pupils can achieve academically and of who they can become.” King’s Oak Academy is therefore an ambitious, values-led community in which staff are trusted, developed and supported to do their best work and where colleagues who share our commitment to high expectations, kindness and inclusive excellence can build a rewarding and sustained career. 

What we can offer you: 

  • Access to a generous pension through the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS). 
  • Generous annual leave. 
  • A comprehensive induction and ongoing commitment to wellbeing and career progression, through a range of training, apprenticeships and in-role/wider-trust development opportunities. 
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme. 
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs. 
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay. 
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking plus many more! 

Recruitment timeline: 

Closing Date:: 22 November 2026 

Interviews: 30 November 2026 

We welcome visits from potential candidates. If you would like to arrange a school visit prior to the closing date, please contact the academy/site directly to arrange a suitable appointment. 

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs, a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form. 

Skilled Worker visas cannot be sponsored through this role.  

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role.

We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or require any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process please let us know how we can assist.

title: Learning Support Assistant
description:
The opportunity:

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Learning Support Assistant or someone with relevant experience of working with young people who is looking to develop a career in SEND support.

We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Learning Support Assistant to join our SEND department. The successful candidate will be passionate about supporting young people to achieve their potential and thrive in our highly successful all-girls school. A comprehensive programme of professional development is available through the school's CPD offer.

This role is linked to the student’s EHCP funding.

What we offer:

  • A unique selling point as a school within an all girls’ schools trust
  • An excellent working environment that prioritises the wellbeing of its staff and students
  • A vibrant CPD programme with the opportunity to pursue National professional qualifications and collaborate across the trust
  • A two-week October half-term break
  • A generous contributory pension scheme
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Free tea/coffee/squash available in the staff room
  • Staff end-of-term social events.

Our commitment to you:

At Nonsuch High School for Girls, staff are our most valued asset, and we are deeply committed to wellbeing, professional growth, and creating a supportive working environment. Our school Wellbeing Strategy ensures manageable workload expectations, with staff able to leave site during the school day if needed and support for career aspirations. Staff benefit from a collaborative and friendly community, an exciting programme of professional development, and family-friendly policies, including flexible leave. Situated in 22 acres of beautiful grounds, we offer excellent facilities, a proactive support team, and a strong culture of development through mentoring, CPD, and cross-Trust networking opportunities.

Key responsibilities for the role include:

  • Building positive and supportive relationships with students with SEND, working on a one-to-one basis, in small groups, or within lessons.
  • Delivering targeted interventions to help students overcome barriers to learning, including support with social skills, study skills, and emotional wellbeing.
  • Providing encouragement and constructive feedback to develop students' confidence, independence and self-esteem.
  • Liaising with teaching staff and the SEND team to monitor progress and evaluate the effectiveness of support strategies.

The successful candidate will:

  • Hold GCSE English and Maths (or equivalent) at Grade 5 or above.
  • Have the ability to build effective working relationships with students, parents/carers and colleagues.
  • Be a positive team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrate a genuine commitment to supporting young people with additional learning needs.

title: Backend / Platform Developer Consultant (Temporal & Kubernetes)
description:
Headquarters: United States

 URL: https://bitovi.com

 JOIN OUR TEAM!

 Bitovi is looking for a Backend / Platform Developer Consultant to join us as we transform technology delivery. We build and operate durable, distributed systems for enterprise clients — heavy on Java Services, Temporal for workflow orchestration, Kafka for event streaming, and Kubernetes-native platform engineering on AWS to run it all reliably. If you want to build exceptional systems, take orchestration, systems engineering, and infrastructure seriously, and have ideas for making delivery more collaborative, validation-driven, and swift, we want to work with you!

 Compensation: $120,000 to $190,000 annually, depending on experience, plus annual bonus opportunity.

 PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only considering candidates located in and authorized to work in the United States.

 WHO YOU ARE

 You're experienced building and running applications at the enterprise level, and you're comfortable owning both the code and the infrastructure it runs on. You think like a systems engineer — reasoning about the whole platform, from JVM services and event streams to the clusters and cloud infrastructure underneath them. You thrive when given opportunities to deliver real-world platforms as an integral team member, including large-scale migrations, and you have the expertise to interface and communicate confidently with stakeholders.

 You'll excel in this role at Bitovi if you have:

• Strong working knowledge of Java and the JVM ecosystem (Spring Boot or similar); experience with additional backend languages (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, etc.) is a plus

• Hands-on experience with a durable execution / workflow engine — Temporal preferred (Apache Airflow, Prefect, or similar also relevant) — including modeling workflows and activities, handling retries and timeouts, and reasoning about idempotency and failure modes

• Experience designing and operating Kafka-based event streaming systems: topic and partition design, consumer groups, schema management, and reasoning about ordering, delivery guarantees, and consumer lag

• Experience designing and building GraphQL APIs — schema design, resolvers, and performance concerns (N+1, caching, pagination); federation experience a plus

• Deep, hands-on AWS experience: architecting, deploying, and operating production systems (EKS, networking, IAM, messaging, and data services)

• Solid Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and debugging production workloads

• A systems engineering mindset: understanding of complex scaling issues, concurrency, backpressure, caching strategies, and failure modes across distributed systems

• Experience planning and executing migrations — application replatforming, workflow engine migrations, data/schema migrations, or moving workloads between environments with minimal downtime

• A thorough understanding of CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-style delivery

• Experience with observability in practice — logging, metrics, and tracing (OpenTelemetry a plus)

• Experience building modern microservice-based or serverless applications

• Database schema design and development expertise

 Other skills we value

 Temporal depth

• Running Temporal in production — self-hosted on Kubernetes and/or Temporal Cloud

• Workflow versioning and patching, safe deployments, and long-running workflow migrations

• Worker deployment and tuning (pollers, task queues, concurrency/slot configuration)

• Namespace management, mTLS (SPIFFE/SPIRE or private CA), and capacity/scaling concerns (e.g. APS/TRU on Temporal Cloud

 Kafka & event streaming depth

• Operating Kafka in production (MSK, Confluent, or self-managed on Kubernetes)

• Kafka Connect, Kafka Streams, and schema registry workflows (Avro/Protobuf)

• Migrating between clusters or providers, and integrating Kafka with downstream analytical stores

• Experience with different techniques for processing large datasets, such as Lambda and Kappa architectures

 Platform / DevOps depth

• Building or operating an internal developer platform (IDP) — self-service, paved-path infrastructure for application teams

• GitOps with ArgoCD (or Flux) and a low- or zero-manual-apply delivery model

• Infrastructure as code: Terraform/OpenTofu, and provisioning AWS resources via Crossplane, ACK, or similar

• Writing Kubernetes controllers/operators (controller-runtime, kubebuilder) and working with CRDs

• Helm chart authoring and distribution (including OCI/registry-based)

• Secrets management (External Secrets Operator, etc.), autoscaling (Karpenter, KEDA), and service mesh concepts (Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE)

• EKS or comparable managed Kubernetes at scale

 General

• Interest in working across multiple backend languages

• Additional queueing and messaging technologies (AWS SQS/SNS, RabbitMQ)

• API design across paradigms (GraphQL, REST, gRPC)

• AuthN/AuthZ and related technologies (sessions, API tokens, JWTs)

• Automated testing across the stack (unit, integration, performance/benchmarking)

 WHO WE ARE

 Bitovi partners with companies to build outcome-focused apps and platforms. Our collaborative approach is driven by validation to deliver the swiftest route to the most valuable solution.

 We design and build high-profile applications and the infrastructure behind them — with tests, full docs, and a real deployment process. We run a serious Temporal practice (including large-scale migration and security work for enterprise clients) alongside deep Kubernetes, AWS, and platform engineering work. We discuss and design architectures, review code, and research new technologies. We talk to our clients, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

 We help one another freely. We keep a Slack channel called ask-help, which is constantly used. We develop new skills, build better developer tools, and work on new types of projects regularly.

 Our fully remote team comprises about 70 developers and designers. We welcome diversity and non-traditional paths into professions — we want the right person, not the right collection of tech keywords.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO AT BITOVI

 Build durable systems. Design and implement Java services, Temporal workflows, and Kafka-based event pipelines, and help clients adopt durable execution and event streaming the right way — from first workflow to production scale.

 Lead modernization efforts. Plan and execute large-scale modernization efforts — moving workflows, services, and data between platforms, clusters, and clouds — with safety, observability, and minimal disruption as first-class requirements.

 Own the platform. Build and operate Kubernetes-native infrastructure and CI/CD on AWS so application teams can ship safely and quickly. Treat reliability, observability, and repeatability as part of the deliverable, not an afterthought.

 Consult and manage. Consult with clients to build outcome-driven applications and platforms, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

 Travel. This is a remote, full-time position that requires the ability to travel. We travel an average of 3–5 days every quarter, and we'll always do our best to work with your schedule.

 Teach. We'll discuss opportunities for you to present at conferences, attend and give training, plan and run meetups or local groups, and create various kinds of content in your area of expertise.

 BENEFITS WE OFFER

• Competitive salary and annual bonus opportunity

• Completely remote work with flexible hours

• 401(k) matching

• 4 weeks of paid time off in addition to 8 paid holidays

• Health, dental, and vision insurance offerings

• Paid maternity and paternity leave

• STD, LTD, and Life Insurance coverage

 HOW TO APPLY

 Please share a resume or LinkedIn profile and answer the additional questions via the application link.

 OTHER

 Please note that we are not interested in working with recruiters.

 ID Verification required if invited to an interview.

 All job offers are contingent on passing a background check.

 Candidates must be located in and authorized to work in the United States; we are unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitovi-backend-platform-developer-consultant-temporal-kubernetes

title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote • Canada

 About Upsun

 Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure.

 Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

• Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.

• Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:

• Predictable performance, even at scale

• Secure, compliant environments by default

• Real-time observability and profiling built in

• Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds

• Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely

 The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

 What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

 Our values:

 We make a positive impact.

 We aim for the stars.

 We care for each other.

 Impact of a Senior IT Systems Engineer

 As a Senior IT Engineer, you help shape and improve the systems that our 250+ person remote company relies on every day. Your work spans identity and access, Google Workspace, device management, and our wider SaaS environment.
 Reporting to the IT Director, you take ownership of complex problems and lead improvements from initial assessment through delivery. You identify what needs attention, recommend priorities, and make thoughtful decisions that balance security, reliability, and employee experience. You also help the team build stronger practices through clear documentation, shared knowledge, and practical guidance.

 What to expect

•
 Identity platform: Improve our identity and access services, with Okta at the core. This includes single sign-on, automated account provisioning, multi-factor authentication, access policies, and emergency access. Work with IT and Security to make access secure, consistent, and straightforward.

•
 Google Workspace: Lead the administration and improvement of our Google Workspace environment, including users, groups, Gmail, Drive, shared drives, and security settings. Improve how people collaborate, manage sharing and access, and keep our configuration aligned with business needs.

•
 Device management: Help lead the rollout and ongoing development of JumpCloud and our device management practices across macOS, Windows, and Linux. Define and implement device configurations, security policies, software deployment, and onboarding processes in partnership with IT Operations and Security.

•
 Automation and employee lifecycle: Design and improve onboarding, role changes, and offboarding across identity, devices, and SaaS tools. Use tools such as Okta Workflows, n8n, Python, and APIs to reduce manual work and make processes more reliable.

•
 Continuous improvement: Assess our current systems, identify gaps, and turn findings into practical improvements. Investigate complex issues across connected services, address root causes, and follow through until changes are working well.

•
 SaaS administration and governance: Administer our core internal tools and help evaluate new applications. Establish clear practices for application setup, integrations, access requests, approvals, and access reviews.

•
 Security and compliance: Partner with Security and the Risk and Audit team to implement and maintain controls across identity, Google Workspace, devices, and SaaS tools. Automate evidence collection where practical to support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2.

•
 Project delivery and mentoring: Lead projects from scoping and technical design through rollout and handover. Coordinate dependencies, communicate risks and progress, and help colleagues grow through documentation, reviews, and knowledge sharing.

 What you bring

•
 Broad IT engineering experience: You have hands-on experience across identity, collaboration tools, endpoint management, and SaaS administration. You understand how these systems connect and can troubleshoot problems across them.

• Depth in a core area: You bring strong expertise in at least one of Okta, Google Workspace, or JumpCloud, along with the ability to work across the others. We welcome different strengths; you do not need to be equally expert in all three.

•
 Device management deployment: You have helped deploy or significantly improve an MDM or endpoint management platform. You can turn security and operational requirements into workable configurations, test them, and roll them out with minimal disruption.

•
 Automation and scripting: You build reliable automation using workflow tools, APIs, webhooks, and Python or a comparable scripting language. You consider error handling, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

•
 A track record of improvement: You can share examples of systems or processes you assessed, improved, and delivered, with clear results for employees or the IT team.

•
 Proactive judgment and ownership: You work independently, make sound technical decisions, and know when to involve others. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, explain trade-offs, and take responsibility for the outcome.

•
 Security and compliance awareness: You have implemented controls such as access reviews, secure configurations, or device policies, and understand how to document and demonstrate that they work. Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 is valuable.

•
 Clear communication and collaboration: You work effectively in a fully remote team and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues across cultures. You share knowledge and help others become more effective.

•
 Experience: Typically six or more years in IT engineering, systems administration, identity, or endpoint management, with increasing responsibility for technical decisions and project delivery. Equivalent experience matters more than a specific number of years.

 Bonus points

•
 Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including assessing and integrating identity systems, Google Workspace environments, devices, or SaaS tools.

•
 Experience in a developer-heavy or engineering-led company.

•
 Experience supporting both ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2, including automated evidence collection.

•
 Professional proficiency in French.

 Where we hire

 At Upsun, remote work isn’t just a trend. It’s our foundation. Upsunners are a global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans more than 30 countries and a wide range of experience levels, and we’re currently hiring for this role in Canada . We’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, but we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

 How we hire

 Our interview process is a chance for us to understand how you think, what you’ve built, and what you want to take on next, and for you to get to know us. Together, we’ll explore where your strengths and interests meet the challenges our teams are solving.

 We know a great hire won’t meet every requirement above. If you can see yourself making the team better, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here if someone hadn’t taken a chance on us.

 You can expect 4 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below.

• 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition

• 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, IT)

• 60 Minutes with Team (Senior Director, Site Reliability Engineering, Senior IT Manager)

• 45 Minutes with Executive (Senior Director, FP&A & IT)

 All roles require background checks.

 What we offer

 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp .

 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

 ️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

 Flexible PTO

 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain)

 Company stock options

 Professional development budget

 Office equipment budget

 ‍️ Wellness budget

 Annual team gatherings

 Inclusive parental leave

 ️ Remote work travel program

 You belong here

 At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upsun-senior-it-systems-engineer

title: Cyber Security Manager
description:
Job Title: Cyber Security Manager
Employment Type: Full-time | Permanent | Remote
Location: We welcome applications from candidates across Bulgaria for this fully remote role.Please note that you will need to have the right to work in the Bulgaria, as we are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship.
WE ARE ZIGZAG - THE WORLD’S MOST CONNECTED ​POST-PURCHASE AND RETURNS NETWORK
We are an award-winning eCommerce returns and post purchase specialist, founded in 2015.

With over 250 team members across the UK, Bulgaria, France, Portugal, Germany, and Spain, we are continually innovating the after-checkout experience for our retailers by reducing cost and complexity, driving sustainability, and fostering customer loyalty.

Today, our SaaS platform provides access to over 3,000 carrier lanes across 170 countries, supporting more 1,100 retailers including our leading enterprise and logistics clients The Very Group, New Look, Boden, Selfridges, Sports Direct, The Hut Group, Swarovski, L’Occitane, Photobox, Carrefour, Lands’ End and DHL.

We were the experts in returns. Now we are the experts in the whole post-purchase experience!
👉 Discover more:

OUR CULTURE AND VALUESOur culture is built on three core values, Start-up Spirit, Human Heart, and a Grown-up Mindset which guide how we collaborate and make decisions.
It isn’t something written on posters – it’s something we bring to life every day through our actions, our relationships, and how we show up for each other and our customers.
Everyone plays a role in shaping our culture through how we communicate, support one another, and celebrate success. Being a ZigZagger means taking ownership, bringing curiosity and energy to everything you do, showing resilience when challenges arise, and leading with care by putting “we before me.” You’ll use sound judgment, stay open to new perspectives, and continuously look for ways to learn, grow, and improve.

About the Role

As our Cyber Security Manager & Data Protection Officer (DPO), you will lead and strengthen security, privacy, and compliance across our SaaS platform, cloud infrastructure, and wider technology environment.
You will develop and deliver security and data protection strategies, manage cyber and privacy risks, ensure compliance with GDPR and industry standards, and protect both company and customer data. Working closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, IT, Legal, and business leaders, you will champion security and privacy-by-design principles, drive best practice, and promote a strong culture of security awareness.
As the designated DPO, you will oversee data protection governance, provide expert GDPR guidance, and act as the key contact for privacy-related matters. This is a hands-on role combining strategic leadership with operational delivery, helping to safeguard the business, maintain customer trust, and support continued growth.
Core Responsibilities

Security Operations, Threat Detection & Incident Response
  • Detect Attacks: Take a hands-on role in monitoring, detecting, investigating, and responding to cyber threats and security incidents affecting the organisation.
  • Investigate Attacks: Investigate security alerts, suspicious activity, attempted intrusions, compromised accounts, and potential breaches.
  • Prevent Attacks: Proactively identify and address security weaknesses through security assessments, hardening activities, and the implementation of appropriate technical controls.
  • Respond to Breaches: Lead and coordinate the investigation and response to security incidents, including ransomware, phishing, credential theft, unauthorised access, account takeover, malicious API activity, and cloud infrastructure compromise. Maintain incident response plans and playbooks, conduct root-cause analysis, and drive remediation activities to strengthen security resilience.
  • Manage Vulnerabilities: Lead vulnerability management activities, ensuring risks are identified, prioritised, remediated, and tracked to completion.
  • Implement and manage security monitoring, detection, and response capabilities using technologies such as SIEM, EDR/XDR, cloud-native security monitoring, and other security tools.
  • Analyse security logs, network activity, endpoint telemetry, and cloud events to identify indicators of compromise and potential attacks.
  • Develop and maintain security detection rules, alerting capabilities, and automated security controls.
  • Work closely with Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Product teams to secure applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and business systems.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting activities to identify suspicious behaviour, indicators of compromise, and emerging threats that may not trigger automated alerts.
  • Manage relationships with external security providers, auditors, and incident response partners when specialist support is required.
  • Improve Resilience: Ensure security incidents and assessments result in measurable improvements to controls, monitoring, and overall security resilience.
Governance, Risk & Compliance
  • Own and maintain the organisation's Information Security Management System (ISMS).
  • Maintain the information security risk register and conduct organisation-wide security risk assessments.
  • Develop and maintain security policies, standards, procedures, and governance frameworks.
  • Report on security posture, risks, incidents, and improvement initiatives to senior stakeholders.
  • Ensure security and privacy requirements are embedded into business projects, products, and technology initiatives.
  • Drive continuous improvement of security governance, risk management, and compliance capabilities.
  • Oversee supplier and third-party security assurance activities.
Compliance & Audit
  • Lead and maintain compliance with recognised standards and frameworks, including ISO 27001, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials Plus, GDPR, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Manage internal and external security, compliance, and data protection audits, ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
  • Support customer security and privacy due diligence activities, including questionnaires, assessments, and audits.
  • Assess security and data protection risks associated with third-party suppliers and service providers.
  • Monitor emerging regulatory, security, and privacy requirements, ensuring policies, controls, and processes remain compliant and effective.
  • Champion a culture of security and privacy by design, embedding security and privacy requirements throughout the organisation.
Data Protection Officer (DPO)
  • Act as the organisation's appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO).
  • Oversee data protection governance, privacy compliance, Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and privacy risk management.
  • Manage data subject rights requests, privacy incidents, breach management, and regulatory reporting obligations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for regulators, customers, and internal stakeholders on data protection and privacy matters.
  • Provide expert guidance on GDPR and wider privacy obligations across the business.
Training & Awareness
  • Develop and deliver security awareness and privacy training programmes.
  • Provide practical security guidance to technical and business teams.
  • Promote a security-first culture across the organisation.
Leadership
  • Lead and mentor security specialists or analysts where applicable.
  • Manage external security vendors and consultants.
  • Drive continuous improvement across security capabilities and processes.

Essential Technical Experience

The successful candidate must demonstrate:
  • Proven hands-on experience leading cyber security investigations, incident response activities, and risk-based decision-making during security incidents.
  • Experience implementing and managing Identity & Access Management (IAM) controls, including authentication, authorisation, privileged access, and identity governance.
  • Experience leading vulnerability management programmes, including risk assessment, remediation, and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of security architecture principles and secure-by-design approaches across SaaS and cloud environments.
  • Experience designing and maintaining network security controls, including segmentation, firewalls, and secure connectivity.
  • Expertise in endpoint security, including EDR/XDR, device management, and threat protection.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM technologies, including log analysis, alert tuning, threat detection, and investigation.
  • Experience embedding DevSecOps practices into software development and deployment lifecycles.
  • Strong knowledge of application security, including secure coding, security testing, and secure SDLC practices.
  • Strong understanding of common cyber threats, attack techniques, threat actors, and exploitation methods.
  • Hands-on experience securing SaaS applications, APIs, authentication systems, and cloud environments, ideally within AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, Product, and business teams.
Qualifications (Desirable)
  • CISSP
  • CISM
  • CCSP
  • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
  • Data protection qualification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, BCS Practitioner Certificate in Data Protection (PC.dp), or equivalent.

What We Offer

  • 20 days’ annual leave plus public holidays, with additional holiday entitlement awarded for each completed year of service (up to a maximum of six extra days). Plus, to celebrate you, enjoy an extra day off on your birthday.
  • Collaborative working environment
  • Remote or hybrid work options – remote working with possibility to work from our Varna office
  • Healthcare insurance with dental service included
  • Food vouchers ( €102.26 month per person)
👉Explore our full range of benefits here: ZigZag Bulgaria Social Benefits.pdf
If you are interested, please send your CV in English.

Equity, Inclusion & Transparency
In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we are committed to transparency and will share the salary range for this role prior to the interview stage.

A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging is a priority, and applications are welcomed from people of all backgrounds and experiences. Reflecting how we live our own values of meritocracy over hierarchy, even if not every requirement is met, interest in the role is encouraged.

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified

TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

The Role

The title says "marketing designer". The job is much bigger than that. You'll help decide how our brand evolves as we move into bigger markets with bigger ideas.

You will be seen as a leader within the TrustedHousesitters creative studio and bring innovative, creative ideas to the table.

Our tone is bold, cheeky and a little rebellious, and we want someone who can push that further while keeping the trust our members rely on.

This is a hands-on senior role. You'll take work nose to tail, from the first idea to delivering every piece of artwork, with performance data showing how you're doing.

What you'll do

  • Take always-on paid social, our biggest acquisition lever, from concept to delivery. That means ads that are funny, bold and different and still hit conversion and engagement benchmarks.
  • Lead creative ideas on your own, pulling together small groups (usually you and a copywriter) and bringing strong, goal-focused concepts back to the senior team
  • Bring the brand to life through motion, animation and video, and take the lead on motion across the studio.
  • Help to support on larger brand activation briefs such as photography, motion shoots and events.

  • Prototype quickly and iterate with modern workflows, including gen AI tools, and lead the studio on tooling.
  • Optimise creative using performance data and leveraging the insights to creatively advertise to our ICPs.

  • Performance creative: hands-on experience designing for paid social and digital ad formats (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, GDN), including vertical, short-form and UGC-style content, and using data to improve results

title: Consultant Neurologist PAYE
description:
Our patients have often tried everything. Years of appointments, medications that did not work, conditions that slowly took over their lives. By the time they reach us, many have run out of road with conventional treatment. You could be the clinician that changes that.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultant Neurologists to join our clinical team.

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical call on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is still a young field. The evidence base is growing, best practice is being written in real time, and you will have a genuine hand in shaping it.

You do not need experience with cannabis based medicines. You need sound clinical judgement, an open mind and an interest in doing things differently. We provide full specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks, so your time is spent where it matters: with patients.

What you will be doing:

  • Providing high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment

  • Conducting patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management

  • Contributing to clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practice

  • Supporting clinical governance and maintaining robust standards of patient care

  • Working closely within a multidisciplinary team of nurses and pharmacists

  • Taking part in ongoing training and development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBPMs)

What you need:

  • Full GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Neurology

  • A genuine interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

Why join us?

  • Highly competitive salary

  • Flexible working with full time or part time options

  • Comprehensive indemnity coverage. Montu covers all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

  • Private healthcare scheme

  • No night shifts and no on call

  • CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

  • A collaborative multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

  • The chance to be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK

Training and development:

  • Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians, sponsored by Montu

  • Specialist training delivered by experts

  • Ongoing support on clinical protocols, prescribing practices and Montu's systems

Working arrangements:

  • Fully remote with flexible working hours and days

  • Standard sessions are 4 hours of patient consultations, and you choose your preferred days and hours

  • To support onboarding, we ask for a minimum commitment of 2 sessions per week (8 hours) initially, so you become confident with our platform

  • Appointments are 15 minutes for new and existing patients. Our multidisciplinary model means nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, so Consultants focus on prescribing and patient care

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines. We exist to transform lives by improving access to safe, effective treatment and delivering an exceptional standard of care. We move quickly, we care deeply about our patients, and we are building something that did not exist in UK healthcare five years ago.

If that sounds like your kind of place, we would love to hear from you.

We are also passionate about the connections we build with our customers. You’ll not only work with some of the world’s most recognized brands, but build lasting relationships.

At Quantum Metric we value all types of experience and education and don’t expect you to meet every qualification for this position. We are most interested in the unique perspective you can bring and your ability to uphold our values of passion, persistence, and integrity.

As an Enterprise Solutions Engineer (EMEA) at Quantum Metric, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor supporting complex, high-value sales opportunities across the region. Working in close partnership with Enterprise Account Executives, you will engage with large, multinational organizations to help them transform how they understand and optimize digital customer experiences.

You will connect with diverse audiences—from digital and product teams to C-level executives—positioning Quantum Metric as a critical component of enterprise digital transformation.

  • Communication: Exceptional storytelling and presentation skills tailored for diverse corporate environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with agentic AI, enterprise data architecture, or tagging strategies.

As a leader in digital analytics, Quantum Metric helps organizations put customers at the heart of everything they do. title: Director of Global Strategy
location: Bellingham, MA, London, United Kingdom, Macclesfield, United Kingdom, Wilmington, DE
description:
Overview

The Strategy & Transformation group at Waters Corporation supports the Executive Committee (EC) in the development and execution of enterprise strategy. In addition to running the annual Strategic Planning process, the group drives critical initiatives across all functions and geographies. Serving as a development engine for external and internal talent, the group attracts diverse, high-potential talent who build their skills and network prior to transitioning into leadership roles in the business or other functions.

As Director, Global Strategy you will collaborate with EC members and other senior leaders on their most important initiatives. You will lead cross-functional teams that change the practice of science, touching all facets of R&D, Manufacturing and Quality. You will have the opportunity to shape your project portfolio according to interests and future career aspirations.

The ideal candidate will possess strong scientific expertise in the life sciences and relevant business experience, as well as the strategic skills to architect and manage a diverse set of projects. They will have the ability to think holistically and long-term across a broad spectrum of industry trends, issues and approaches to communicate business objectives and priorities to a variety of internal and external stakeholders.

The candidate is required to have strong interpersonal skills and work with multiple internal stakeholders to drive and support highly visible and time-sensitive projects. Furthermore, the candidate will be able to partner flexibly within our organization to develop and deliver scientific, clinical, technical and commercial assessments and evaluations relevant to Waters strategic goals.

Responsibilities

As a Director for Global Strategy, your responsibilities will include to:

  • Lead / manage strategic projects for Waters as defined by the CEO and EC:
    • Lead cross-functional teams to successful outcomes with clear impact
    • Ensure that project collaborations with external consultants are well-managed
    • Prepare recommendations and present updates to leadership
    • Multi-task in balancing large book of work while ensuring consistent attention and prioritization of most critical and visible projects
    • Role model leadership and scientific rigor within the Waters culture
  • Support annual Strategic Planning Process
    • Lead components of company-wide strategy process in collaboration with business and function leaders through the matrixed organization
    • Facilitate workshops and prioritization exercises, provide constructive criticism and independent analysis, push to define targets and meaningful KPIs
  • Identify and assess major business opportunities
  • Support identification and evaluation of organic and inorganic business opportunities that could impact growth and profitability
    • Collect diverse perspectives and market research, including from external networks
    • Provide independent recommendations to EC
  • Drive people development and cultural change
    • Cultivate a broad and deep network across the company and externally
    • Recruit talented individuals as collaborators and future group members
    • Develop members of teams, providing feedback and coaching
    • Assist with communicating and setting an example of our aspirational culture and strategic directions

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree strongly preferred (PhD, MD, MBA) with scientific or engineering discipline a plus
  • Consulting background strongly recommended, with project management experience
  • Prior experience in life sciences tools, diagnostics, med device, biopharma or other relevant industries strongly preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sharp business and financial acumen
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with ability to influence the thinking of senior management
  • Team player and network-builder with desire to grasp new technology and change the world
  • Energetic, self-disciplined, creative and mature with a customer orientation and strong leadership potential

Company Description

Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of ~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.

Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. It benefits our employees, our products, our customers and our community. Waters complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to sex, race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, marital status (including civil unions), military service, veteran status, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, legally recognized disability, domestic violence victim status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Waters is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

title: Senior Sales Recruiter
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Let’s be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They’re seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the ‘doing more with less’ memos. If you’re currently at a startup that’s struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that ‘growth’ story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy.

And we aren't just stable—we’re expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we’re looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense.

The Challenge:
