description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

#LI-IV1

The role

The Service Desk IT Operations Lead is the senior individual contributor on the Service Desk path and the senior technical escalation point for Service Desk across EMEA and APAC. The role owns and improves Service Desk processes, runbooks, escalation paths, the employee hardware lifecycle and new-hire IT onboarding, administers Service Desk tooling on behalf of its owners, and leads improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects. It acts as the bridge between the Service Desk and Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications and Security, and leads through expertise, judgment and influence rather than formal authority. It carries no line-management responsibility.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Serve as the final technical escalation point within Service Desk for high-severity, high-complexity and business-critical issues, before engagement of Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications, Security or vendors; coordinate major-incident response, communication and post-incident follow-through with the relevant teams.

  • Act as consultation point for L1/L2 on complex or unusual cases: advise on troubleshooting approach, ownership, escalation path and resolution before issues are escalated.

  • Act as subject matter expert for the end-user computing environment: endpoints (Windows, macOS), mobile devices, identity and access (Entra ID / Active Directory, SSO, MFA), Microsoft 365, MDM, collaboration tools and meeting-room technology.

  • Administer and configure Service Desk tooling (e.g. Jira Service Management workflows and automation, device enrolment and MDM policy, hardware asset management tooling) as agreed with the tool and platform owners, and propose and implement improvements, including request workflows and automations used by adjacent functions. Ownership of the tools and platforms sits with IT leadership and platform owners.

  • Administer selected corporate IT systems and services according to operational requirements, including access and permissions management, service configuration and automation.

  • Maintain and improve Service Desk procedures, runbooks, escalation paths and knowledge base; propose technical standards for approval by Service Desk management and maintain them once approved; advise on operational priorities.

  • Contribute to creating and updating documentation: runbooks, process documents, technical standards and knowledge-base articles, setting the standard for documentation quality across the team.

  • Analyze ticket, escalation and SLA data to identify systemic issues and contribute to SLA reporting; lead root-cause analysis and problem management; design process, tooling and automation changes that improve first-time resolution and reduce escalation volume.

  • Assess proposed solutions and operational changes for supportability and user impact; advise management and partner teams on the support implications of technology decisions.

  • Provide organizational context on existing and legacy IT processes, systems, decisions and ownership structures; apply it when evaluating current processes, and improve legacy practices where appropriate.

  • Identify gaps or ambiguities in operational ownership and work with the relevant stakeholders to establish practical solutions.

  • Own and improve employee-lifecycle processes, including hardware provisioning and, with Onboarding and People teams, new-hire IT onboarding across EMEA and APAC.

  • Recommend standards for company-provided laptops, peripherals and other end-user equipment, balancing business need, supportability, lifecycle and market availability; maintain the approved standards.

  • Own employee hardware lifecycle processes, provisioning, replacement, reuse, return, disposal and employee resale, and provide demand forecasts and regional requirements (including Bill & Hold) to IT Supply Chain and Procurement; recommend routine purchases against agreed standards, approving only within a documented delegated spend limit.

  • Lead and continuously improve equipment reuse and employee resale, including TechShop.

  • Contribute to forecasting and budget planning for employee technology and Service Desk requirements.

  • Support Service Desk contracts, renewals and licensing; maintain working relationships with hardware and Service Desk vendors.

  • Lead Service Desk projects, system migrations, new technology rollouts, process optimization, and contribute Service Desk expertise to company initiatives such as regional expansion, office launches, organizational changes and onboarding improvements, working with Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications, Security, HR/People, Onboarding, Recruiting, Procurement, Workplace/Facilities and the AV/Builds team.

  • Advise partner functions on Service Desk capabilities, procedures, requirements and dependencies, and work with them to define and improve shared operational processes (e.g. joiner/mover/leaver with People, office launches with Workplace).

  • Act as technical interviewer in Service Desk recruitment, providing structured feedback and hiring recommendations to management, and technical input to role requirements.

  • Deliver technical onboarding for new team members and mentor L1 and L2 through joint troubleshooting, coaching and knowledge transfer, documenting approaches to reduce reliance on individual knowledge.

  • Stay hands-on: support the IT Bar, queue and events alongside L1/L2 when needed, and lead by example on ticket quality and communication.

  • Provide operational evidence for audits and compliance (including equipment lifecycle and offboarding); follow security, access-governance and procurement requirements; escalate material concerns to the appropriate owner.

We expect you to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of IT support or service desk experience with demonstrated progression in responsibility.

  • Advanced technical certifications (Microsoft 365, Azure, ITIL Intermediate, Security+, etc.) strongly preferred.

  • Deep knowledge of enterprise IT systems, networks, and security practices.

  • Strong leadership, coaching, and collaboration skills.

  • Proven ability to manage high-priority incidents and lead cross-functional troubleshooting efforts.

Related Competencies

  • Knowledge & Skills

    • Recognised expert in end-user computing and support operations, with breadth across endpoints, identity, collaboration, device management and security touch points.

      Diagnoses ambiguous, cross-platform issues; experienced in root-cause analysis and process optimisation.

      Translates complex issues into clear guidance for technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Autonomy

      Takes the most sensitive escalations from intake to follow-up.

      Independently identifies improvements and drives them to completion; proactively pitches projects within the Service Desk domain.

      Advises management and partner teams on the support implications of technology decisions. Significant spend, strategic or organisational changes, and decisions outside delegated authority are aligned with management.

  • Complexity

      Leads escalations, often coordinating multiple IT functions.

      Designs and improves workflows and procedures where no precedent exists.

  • Impact

      Reduces downtime, repeat incidents and escalation volume.

      Shapes employee technology from onboarding through equipment return; ensures knowledge transfer and team readiness.

title: Talent Lead
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs has grown to over 1,000 in three years, and the rate of growth is not slowing down. As Talent Lead, you will be in charge of one of the most visible and impactful functions in the company: hundreds of hires a quarter across Research, Engineering, GTM and Operations, in one of the most competitive talent markets in history. You’ll move Talent from a high-volume recruiting engine to a strategic partner that tells leaders what is achievable, and you’ll rebuild how we hire using the same AI products we make.

You'll run the entire Talent team (currently 20 - 30 recruiters, sourcers, and talent operations) across verticals, setting the strategy, building the systems, and staying hands-on where it matters. You'll report directly to the Operations Lead and be a close partner to the People team. This isn't a pure executive role - we want someone who still loves the craft of recruiting and can model what great looks like for the team around them.

The right person has done this before at scale - at a company that grew fast and hired harder. Your team will look to you not just for direction, but as someone they can genuinely learn from. This will be an opportunity to shape the direction of Talent at ElevenLab; where we go, how we get there and who we get there with. If you want to shape the future of the Talent industry by building industry-defining playbooks using the latest technology and AI solutions, whilst building an expert team - this might be your best fit yet.

In this role you will:

  • Lead the full talent function across Research, GTM, Engineering & Product, and G&A hiring - setting strategy, managing team performance, building a recruiter capacity engine, and driving outcomes across all verticals.

  • Shape Talent Operations: ATS (Ashby) configuration, headcount tracking, hiring velocity metrics, and recruiter tooling - ensuring the function runs with precision and minimal friction.

  • Identify innovative ways of approaching Talent: design the next-gen Talent org structure, envision how Talent processes can be agentified and work with the team to build ElevenLabs products throughout.

  • Act as a strategic partner to department heads and hiring managers, bringing market intelligence, pipeline health visibility, and honest counsel on what it takes to consistently win the best people in the market.

  • Build and maintain a strong talent brand through thoughtful candidate experience, community engagement, building a Talent events program and creative sourcing strategies.

  • Coach and develop a team of recruiters, establishing clear standards for quality of hire, speed, and candidate experience.

  • Partner with functional leaders across Research, Engineering, GTM, and Operations - acting as a trusted advisor who can challenge, align, and mobilize leaders around talent priorities and workforce strategy.

We’re moving quickly on this search. Applications close on 13 November 2026, and we’ll start reviewing right away, so we’d encourage you to apply early.

Requirements

  • Proven track record leading large TA functions at high-growth companies, with direct experience filling hundreds of roles per year across multiple functions and geographies.

  • Hands-on recruiting instincts - comfortable being in the weeds on critical searches, not just managing from a distance.

  • Strong people leader who builds, develops, and retains recruiting talent.

  • Sharp on process: able to design and iterate on systems, tooling, and workflows that make a team of 20–30 perform at a high level with AI.

  • Close collaborator with People, Finance, and business leaders - comfortable operating at the intersection of headcount planning, compensation, and hiring strategy.

  • Held a high bar for quality of hire while hitting aggressive volume, with the metrics to show it.

  • Advised founders and executive suite on workforce planning, and changed a plan with your judgment.

  • Worked with Finance, People and RevOps on headcount planning, capacity modelling, compensation and offer strategy.

  • Has recruited across the Americas, EMEA and APAC and understands the differences between markets.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with the ability to operate from New York or London strongly preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

We’re looking for a Senior Hypervisor Engineer to contribute to the development of our hyperscaler platform.
The Hypervisor team supports and develops the parts of the Cloud platform that directly affect the KVM hypervisor and QEMU device emulator. We understand the granular details of hardware virtualization and device emulation, paying close attention to performance and protection against untrusted code.
You will work on substantial extensions for the QEMU/KVM virtualization stack in close cooperation with the opensource community.

  • Integrate the hypervisor with other platform services and storage facilities for user data
  • Efficiently distribute resources between virtual machines
  • Improve guest system support
  • Advance the cutting-edge of open source virtualization

  • Fluent in C programming language
  • 3+years of experience with Linux
  • At least 3 years of engineering experience with QEMU/KVM
  • General understanding of x86-compatible systems (virtual memory, interrupts, privilege rings)
  • Experience writing general system code in user mode for Linux, including debugging, analysis, and optimization tools (the emulator is built on the user mode system process for Linux)

It would be an added bonus if you had:

  • Experience working with Linux kernel
  • Some experience with ARMv8, including virtualization extensions

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

Our Global Ops Team ⭐️

At Monzo, our customers should receive great service regardless of where it is delivered. As our UK and EU operations grow, we need clear direction and dedicated leadership to turn our partner estate strategy into customer, quality and commercial outcomes.

The Partner Strategy and Delivery Lead exists to define the direction, priorities and focus areas for the Partner Strategy and Delivery pillar. You will translate Monzo’s wider goals and agreed estate principles into a coherent portfolio of work, create the conditions required for delivery and influence the wider business to enable successful outcomes.

Delivery is expected at every level within the pillar. In this role, most of your time will be spent defining what the team should focus on, why it matters and what success looks like, then enabling and assuring delivery through the wider team and business.

You will lead a team of 5 senior/mid-senior colleagues. You may also directly lead or intervene in the most material, complex or sensitive activity where senior ownership is required.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

Strategy, direction and portfolio focus

  • Strategic alignment & roadmap execution: Translate Monzo and GCOO objectives into a clear partner estate strategy, establishing actionable roadmaps, governance frameworks, and supporting strategies aligned with operational goals.

Partner estate and thematic agenda

  • Estate optimisation & market strategy: Evaluate the global partner estate holistically to resolve systemic operational themes, leverage market trends, and sponsor recommendations across location strategy, footprint changes, and operating models.

title: Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph | United Kingdom | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph

This is a remote position based in the United Kingdom.

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success.

As Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph, you'll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best.

Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences.

You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Enabling customers to easily understand and explore how their systems connect to each other. Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user
  • Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity
  • Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives
  • Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team
  • Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations
  • Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements
  • Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users
  • A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them
  • Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind
  • Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space
  • Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces with a focus on clarity
  • Ability to rapidly gain an understanding of a technical domain and associated customer needs and user workflows in order to design effective experiences within that domain
  • Domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring
  • Experience helping design teams, especially at engineering led companies, level up their practice, collaboration with partner functions, and user and organizational impact

When you apply, please:

  • Provide an example of an experience where decision-making in a complex area is made easy through a well-curated UI. Add a sentence or two about what you believe makes it effective.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 83,726 - GBP 100,470. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

title: Field Technical Lead – Data Center Deployments
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius is building next-generation AI infrastructure at scale. We are looking for a Field Technical Lead to drive on-site execution of new data center deployments, leading technical teams and contractors while ensuring high-quality, on-time delivery. This position requires frequent travel to data centers during key deployment phases. The person in this role can be located anywhere in the EU but must be available for regular travel to data center deployments around EU/UK.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Technically lead on-site deployment of GPU-based compute clusters, storage systems, and high-speed networking in data centers.
  • Support Project Managers in planning, coordinating, and tracking project delivery activities.
  • Organize and supervise contractors, vendors, and internal technical teams to ensure smooth execution of deployment workstreams.
  • Proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical and operational issues during deployments.
  • Maintain clear and accurate project documentation, including deployment plans, risk logs, issue trackers, and acceptance reports.
  • Ensure transparent communication with all stakeholders by providing regular status updates, escalating blockers, and managing expectations.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, networking, operations, and supply chain.
  • Participate in related project activities such as automation initiatives, process improvements, and post-deployment support when required.

We expect you to have:

  • Proactive, ownership-driven leader with the ability to anticipate issues, drive decisions on-site, and lead teams through complex deployments.
  • Proven hands-on experience with data center infrastructure deployments, ideally in high-performance computing or AI-focused environments.
  • Strong understanding of data center operations including racking, structured cabling, power planning, and cooling considerations.
  • Technical knowledge of GPU servers, compute nodes, storage platforms, and high-speed networking technologies.
  • Experience working within project delivery frameworks, collaborating closely with Project Managers, and managing subcontractors or vendors.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues in on-site, time-critical environments.
  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to document processes, maintain tracking systems, and produce clear, structured deployment and status reports.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Understanding of construction projects structure and key risk factors in facility build-outs.
  • Knowledge of HPC
  • Experience in business processes design or automation tools development.
  • PMP, PRINCE2, or similar industry certifications.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

The Fraud Investigator role within our Pursue pillar facilitates and acts on vital communication between Monzo and other institutions; helping us to prevent the loss of funds to fraudsters both within Monzo and across the industry. This communication falls into three main categories:

  • Communication to and from CIFAS about potential fraudsters in Monzo’s customer base

  • Creating and actioning indemnities and defunds where needed
  • Reporting to CIFAS

  • Previous experience in customer service or a related field

  • Strong expertise in investigating, problem solving and decision making

title: Electrical Engineer- Data Centers
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Infrastructure Acquisition Group

The Infrastructure Acquisition Group secures the land, power, and data center capacity that enables the Nebius AI Cloud. We identify where Nebius should grow next, structure the commercial agreements that make that growth possible, and partner across engineering, energy, finance, legal, and development to bring new AI infrastructure online.

We're a small, founding team building this function from the ground up across the Americas, leading the acquisition of colocation, build-to-suit, powered land, and other strategic infrastructure opportunities as one of the world's fastest-growing AI cloud platforms scales.

Examples of Problems We're Solving

Validate electrical feasibility before commercial commitment. A site or agreement is only as good as its ability to support the power capacity and distribution infrastructure required to run it. You'll lead electrical due diligence, utility interconnection analysis, and equipment feasibility review to inform Go / No-Go decisions before deals close.

Keep electrical design decisions ahead of development. Coordinate with Site Selection, Development, Engineering, and Delivery so power distribution topology, redundancy strategy, and equipment assumptions are validated early enough to protect schedule and budget once construction begins.

Build a repeatable technical evaluation program. Help establish the standards, design criteria, and technical readiness gates that will support electrical engineering review across every AI infrastructure acquisition in the Americas.

About the Role

As an Electrical Engineer, you'll provide the technical electrical engineering perspective across the acquisition and development lifecycle — from initial site and deal evaluation through construction readiness. Working within the Infrastructure Acquisition Group, you'll partner with Site Selection, Technical Due Diligence, Development, Energy, Finance, and Delivery to ensure every project's power distribution, utility interconnection, and equipment assumptions are technically sound before they move forward.

This is a build-phase role on a build-phase team. Many of the technical evaluation standards, design criteria, and readiness gates you'll use are still being written — in some cases, you'll help write them. We're looking for someone who can independently assess complex electrical infrastructure while helping build the systems that make every future evaluation faster, more predictable, and more scalable.

What You'll Own

  • Lead electrical engineering evaluation of prospective sites, colocation capacity, and build-to-suit opportunities.
  • Own technical assumptions for power distribution topology, capacity, and equipment strategy feeding the pre-construction risk register.
  • Assess utility interconnection, on-site generation, and redundancy strategies (N, N+1, 2N) against site conditions and load requirements.
  • Recommend Go / No-Go input on electrical feasibility as projects advance through key development milestones.
  • Deliver technically validated electrical scope to the Delivery organization with complete documentation and minimized risk.

Technical Due Diligence & Feasibility

  • Lead electrical due diligence on prospective sites, existing facilities, and colocation capacity under evaluation.
  • Evaluate utility capacity, interconnection queue position, substation requirements, and on-site generation/UPS strategy against projected IT load.
  • Assess electrical equipment availability, lead times (transformers, switchgear, generators), and vendor constraints that could affect schedule or capex.
  • Ensure electrical assumptions are fully integrated into project budgets, capacity models, and schedules.

Design & Equipment Strategy

  • Partner with Engineering to define power distribution topology and redundancy strategy appropriate to each site and deal structure.
  • Evaluate EPMS/BMS controls integration and electrical system commissioning requirements early in the acquisition process.
  • Provide technical input on switchgear, UPS, and generator selection, redundancy strategy, and capex trade-offs across candidate sites.
  • Ensure electrical design intent is preserved as deals move from negotiation into development.

Construction Readiness

  • Establish electrical technical readiness criteria as part of project handoff standards.
  • Verify electrical design assumptions, equipment specifications, and capacity commitments are complete before turnover to Delivery.
  • Identify and resolve electrical technical risks before they impact construction.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary electrical engineering technical interface across Site Selection, Technical Due Diligence, Development, Energy, and Delivery.
  • Coordinate with consulting engineers, utility providers, equipment vendors, and commissioning agents to validate executable electrical strategies.
  • Align internal stakeholders and external consultants to prevent technical scope drift as projects move from acquisition into development.

What Success Looks Like

  • Ensure every acquisition is grounded in sound electrical engineering judgment before commercial commitment.
  • Deliver predictable, technically validated power distribution and redundancy strategies across the portfolio.
  • Identify and resolve electrical technical risks before they impact construction.
  • Build trusted relationships with utility providers, equipment vendors, consulting engineers, and commissioning partners.
  • Help build the technical standards and evaluation processes the Infrastructure Acquisition Group runs on as it scales.

What You'll Bring

  • You're comfortable operating in ambiguity and building technical evaluation processes where none exist. You know how to independently assess complex electrical infrastructure while helping define how future projects should be evaluated.
  • 8+ years of experience in data center electrical engineering, power systems design, or mission-critical electrical systems.
  • Experience with medium-voltage distribution, switchgear, UPS systems, generators, and utility interconnection for high-density AI/hyperscale environments.
  • Strong understanding of electrical capacity planning, redundancy topology (N, N+1, 2N), equipment selection, and capex trade-offs in data center design.
  • Experience evaluating electrical feasibility of sites or facilities prior to commercial commitment.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting hyperscale data center or AI infrastructure development.
  • Experience with EPMS/BMS controls integration and electrical systems commissioning.
  • Experience with utility interconnection agreements and interconnection queue strategy.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or similar professional certification.
  • Experience evaluating colocation or build-to-suit electrical infrastructure in a due diligence capacity.

Why Join Nebius

The infrastructure supporting AI is being built now. This is an opportunity to help define how Nebius evaluates and designs the power systems behind every AI infrastructure acquisition while helping build the function itself — the technical standards, design criteria, and evaluation framework that will support infrastructure investments across the Americas. You'll work on some of the industry's largest and most complex AI infrastructure developments while helping shape the physical foundation of the global AI economy.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

description:

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍Remote, UK | 💰 | £27,700 - £33,600 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

Start date - 31st January 2027

37.5 hours per week, shifts between 9am-6pm & 1 week in 3 shifts will be 1-10pm & 2 in 4 Saturdays.

⭐ Our Fraud Protect team:

Our Mission in the Financial Crime & Fraud Collective is to earn and keep our customers’ trust, support Monzo’s safe growth, and contribute to building a safer society. Our Fraud Investigators are crucial to the success of this mission.

Our Fraud department operates across three strategic pillars—Protect, Pursue, and Prevent; this specific role sits within the Protect arm, focusing on securing accounts and supporting customers after a fraudulent event has occurred.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

The Fraud Investigator role within our Protect pillar provides vital after-care to Monzo customers who have fallen victim to value fraud across a range of touch points, including:

  • Unauthorised card fraud
  • Unauthorised faster payment fraud
  • Authorised card payment fraud
  • Authorised faster payment fraud
  • Third party account takeover attempts

🔑 You’ll play a key role by:

Fraud Investigators within our protect pillar work within a mixture of regulated and unregulated deadlines. Their role supports the quality of performance and knowledge across the pillar.

  • Gathering evidence from customers’ claim submissions via our In app chat function and calls to and from customers
  • Probing for further evidence where needed
  • Use of Monzo’s values to investigate claims with empathy and attention to detail
  • Making decisions on cases and uphold or decline fraud claims up to a case value of £5,000
  • Submitting accounts for closure where first party concerns are held following investigation (in line with relevant guidance)
  • Triaging cases with a value of more than £5,000.00 for upwards escalation
  • Safeguarding compromised accounts and taking appropriate remedial action to ensure customers can resume safe usage of their Monzo account
  • Providing advice and support to victims of fraud on how they can protect themselves in the future

💰 £27,700 - £33,600 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

description:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Role Purpose Statement:

The Vice President Sales, UKI at Ping Identity is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving revenue growth and achieving sales targets. This position will lead and manage the UKI sales function, develop and execute sales strategies, and foster strong customer relationships. The Vice President will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to optimize sales processes, enhance customer experiences, and contribute to the overall success of Ping Identity.

  • Develop and execute the overall enterprise go-to-market strategy, aligned with the company's business goals and market opportunities.

  • Collaborate with marketing to align sales and marketing initiatives, campaigns, and messaging to generate and nurture leads.
  • Work closely with Product Management to understand customer needs and provide feedback to shape product roadmap and offerings.
  • Develop and implement sales processes, including lead generation, opportunity management, and pipeline management, to maximize sales efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Provide leadership and guidance in sales forecasting, resource planning, and budget management.
  • Collaborate with Sales Operations to implement and optimize sales tools, technologies, and systems to enhance sales productivity and enable data-driven decision-making.
  • Coach and mentor the enterprise sales team, providing guidance, feedback, and professional development opportunities.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies, providing insights and recommendations to drive sales effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Product Management, and Customer Success, to ensure a unified and customer-centric approach.
  • Represent Ping Identity at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings to enhance brand awareness and generate new business opportunities.
  • Stay current on sales best practices and industry certifications.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Extensive experience in a senior leadership role in sales within the technology industry.
  • Experience managing large teams including sales leaders, across a matrixed distributed go-to-market organization.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications:

  • MBA or advanced degree.
  • Experience in sales within the cybersecurity or identity and access management (IAM) industry.
  • Familiarity with sales enablement tools and technologies, such as CRM systems and sales engagement platforms.

title: Company Operations Lead
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves.

As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best. You'll establish the operating layer that keeps a 50-country, hybrid organization coherent; drive the strategic planning cadence that keeps leadership aligned; and deploy a lean team of strategic generalists against the company's most urgent cross-functional challenges.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Operating Cadence: Running the planning and alignment cycles that keep the company pointed in the right direction. This includes OKR planning, workforce, and headcount planning.

  • Operating System: Building and maintaining the infrastructure layer that lets the company move faster. Systems of record, org taxonomy and governance, and the knowledge management systems that ensure information flow effectively across our remote-first team.

  • AI Enablement & Agentification: Ensuring every team at ElevenLabs has the tools, access, and knowledge to work effectively with AI. You'll own the internal AI enablement framework - managing tool access and rollout, identifying where agents and automation can accelerate how functions operate, and building the learning opportunities and champions programmes that drive deep adoption. You'll work closely with Security, IT, and the Automations team to ensure what gets built is built right.

  • Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done.

Requirements

We do not require formal experience, certifications, or degrees. We do require:

  • Proven experience building and leading a Strategy & Operations or BizOps function at a high-growth technology company - ideally through a meaningful scaling inflection (Series B–D trajectory or equivalent).

  • Track record of standing up functions and systems from scratch and handing them off, rather than owning a permanent queue.

  • Structured problem-solving background - strategy consulting, a BizOps or Chief of Staff seat with genuine strategic scope, or an operator role that required both systems-building and executive influence.

  • Strong AI and tooling fluency - you should be pushing the organisation on what's possible with AI enablement, not chasing it.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management: you can partner with founders and Leads and earn trust quickly in a flat, high-velocity environment.

Bonus:

  • Experience inside a company that scaled through a 200 → 2,000+ person inflection.

  • Background that spans both consulting and operator roles - you've done the thinking and the building.

  • Familiarity with knowledge management, AI agentification, or internal tooling as an operational discipline.

Location

This role is remote. London or New York preferred.

#LI-Remote

ElevenLabs operates a complex and fast-evolving revenue model – enterprise contracts, self-serve API subscriptions, usage-based billing, and expanding international markets. As a Revenue Accountant, you will play a key role in ElevenLabs’ revenue accounting function.

You will own significant portions of the monthly revenue close, support the application of ASC 606 to customer arrangements, and help build scalable processes and controls as ElevenLabs grows toward IPO readiness.

You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, Billing Operations, Engineering, and FP&A to support contract review, usage and billing completeness, new product launches, and accurate and timely revenue recognition. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a lean Finance team – the right person will independently run recurring workstreams, identify issues early, and help scale the revenue accounting operating model as the business grows.

What you’ll do

  • Execute significant portions of the monthly revenue close, including journal entries, deferred and unbilled revenue schedules, reconciliations, and flux analysis

  • Perform recurring usage / consumption completeness and billing-to-GL reconciliations; investigate exceptions and drive resolution with cross-functional partners

  • Review customer contracts and apply established ASC 606 guidance to standard arrangements; escalate novel, high-judgment, or precedent-setting matters

  • Support accounting for credits, refunds, contract modifications, cutoff, and variable consideration, with clear and audit-ready documentation

  • Prepare revenue workpapers, audit support, and control evidence; support external audit, walkthroughs, and SOX readiness activities

  • Support accounting readiness and UAT for new products, pricing structures, billing models, and partner / channel launches

  • Improve and automate recurring revenue processes, reconciliations, documentation, and exception reporting as the business scales

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in ASC 606, including multi-element arrangements, SSP evaluation, variable consideration, contract modifications, and principal vs. agent analysis

  • Experience leading the revenue close: deferred revenue management, unbilled receivables, journal entry review, and month-end flux analysis

  • Track record of partnering with Sales and Legal on contract review and revenue impact assessments

  • Experience operating in a pre-IPO or public company environment, with direct exposure to external audit, controls build-out, and revenue accounting documentation

  • CPA, ACA, or ACCA qualification (active); Big 4 or public accounting background a strong plus

  • Strong systems proficiency; Stripe, Metronome, HubiFi or a comparable revenue recognition tool preferred

Bonus:

  • Experience with consumption/usage-based and subscription billing models

  • Familiarity with ASC 326 (CECL) and AR accounting in a high-volume SaaS context

  • Multi-entity or international revenue accounting background

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Central Europe or Eastern US timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

title: Unified Foundational Offers Strategy and Operations Lead
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, California, United States

 URL: https://microsoft.com

 Overview
 Candidate-facing role description

 With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer and Commercial Success (CCS) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction — whether in-product, digital, or human-centered. CCS is responsible for end-to-end services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CCS and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.

 The Service Portfolio and Delivery organization, part of CCS, is leading the effort to enable customer success on the Microsoft Cloud by harnessing leading, AI-powered capabilities and human expertise to deliver innovative solutions that accelerate business value, drive operational excellence, and nurture long-term loyalty. One of the key mechanisms through which Microsoft activates the incredible talent of its technical teams for customer success is Microsoft Unified. Unified enables a proactive approach with customers that accelerates value creation and sustains growth for the Microsoft Cloud. It serves as a growth engine for the company by getting hands-on with customers to understand their priorities and help drive adoption and optimization at speed.

 The Unified Foundational Offers team creates and brings to market commercial offerings that provide expert guidance and problem resolution, ensuring customers get value and success from their Microsoft technologies.

 Role overview

 Lead the portfolio operating layer for Foundational Offers across enterprise and mission-critical services. This is a senior services and support business leadership role, bringing horizontal accountability to a portfolio that spans embedded AI guidance through premium engineering partnership. You will connect portfolio economics, pricing, delivery capacity, engineering priorities and investment returns so that leaders can make coherent decisions across the full support and services ladder.

 Working as a peer to offer program leaders, you will establish shared operating models and turn competing business needs into defensible portfolio choices. Success is measured by decisions changed: pricing revised to protect differentiated customer value, engineering priorities sharpened and capacity assumptions corrected before funding. You will enable stronger revenue and margin quality, retention, value realization and upgrade movement through influence and business judgment, rather than acting as a sole quota owner or a coordination-only program manager.

 Responsibilities
 • Establish a common portfolio taxonomy and revenue-attribution framework so offer leaders, Finance and delivery teams work from a single view of offers, customer value, delivery models and economics.

 • Own the integrated demand and capacity model across support, customer success and engineering. Test how AI deflection and autonomous resolution change human demand, cost-to-serve and premium-service capacity, using delivery-owner inputs rather than replacing their accountability.

 • Shape coherent pricing architecture across percentage-of- product-value , consumption and bespoke or multi-year motions. Challenge structures that undercut premium tiers, preserve increasing value across the service ladder and ensure delivery economics support sustainable margin.

 • Arbitrate competing engineering and commerce-platform asks into one ranked portfolio priority list. Bring evidence-based trade-offs to cross-functional leaders and connect investment choices to customer outcomes, delivery feasibility and expected returns.

 • Define a common portfolio scorecard spanning cost-to-serve, margin, renewals, attach and upgrade movement, and campaign influence. Align definitions for AI deflection, autonomous resolution and time-to-guidance where relevant; use the scorecard to improve decisions, not simply report activity.

 • Set the portfolio governance model, decision standards and accountability expectations. Partner with offer program leaders and operational coordination support to embed the models in business rhythms, resolve cross-portfolio tensions and communicate defensible consolidated positions.

 Qualifications
 Required qualifications

 • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or a related field AND 10+ years of experience in product management, program management, process management, or process improvement — • OR equivalent experience.

 Preferred qualifications
 • Master’s Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or a related field.
• Demonstrated leadership of a services or support business, with accountability for a P&L or portfolio scorecard and evidence of improving business decisions and outcomes.
• Fluency in portfolio economics, cost-to-serve, demand and capacity modeling, and investment-return analysis; ability to turn uncertain assumptions into actionable operating choices.
• Strong commercial judgment in pricing and service-tier differentiation, including the ability to challenge proposals that weaken customer value progression or delivery economics.
• Credibility with Finance, support delivery and product engineering leaders; demonstrated ability to influence senior peers, arbitrate competing priorities and drive adoption without relying on direct authority.
• Ability to establish common definitions, decision rights and operating models across a complex portfolio, and explain trade-offs clearly to executive and cross-functional audiences.
• Experience integrating enterprise support, customer success and premium mission-critical services into a coherent portfolio operating model.
• Experience assessing how AI-enabled guidance, deflection or autonomous resolution affects service demand, capacity and customer outcomes.
• Experience with consumption-based, value-linked and bespoke or multi-year service pricing, and with commerce or engineering transformation prioritization.
• Experience building portfolio scorecards that connect retention, attach and upgrade behavior, delivery economics and investment decisions.

title: Shield Program Lead
description:
Headquarters: Canada

 URL: https://www.guesty.com

 Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup that’s transforming how the industry works — from guest experience to business growth.
 With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners — including Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com , Expedia, Google Travel, and many more — Guesty empowers property managers to deliver top-tier guest experiences while running more efficient, data-driven operations.
 We’re proud to have over 900+ team members across 16 countries worldwide, all working together to build the future of hospitality technology.
 If you’re looking to grow your career in a dynamic, global, and impact-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you.
 We are looking for a Shield Program Lead to take end-to-end ownership of the operations and ongoing performance of Guesty Shield globally.
 You will lead the internal claims team, manage commercial relationships with insurers and program partners, and ensure customers receive a reliable experience from enrollment through claims resolution and payment. You will drive improvements in customer retention, operational efficiency and program profitability, while leading new product launches and improvements alongside Product and other internal teams.
 This is a hands-on role for someone with experience in the short-term rental/vacation rental industry who can manage people, lead commercial discussions and follow through on operational details.

 Responsibilities

 Program Operations
 • Own the day-to-day operation of Shield across all active markets, with clear processes, accountability and consistent service delivery.
• Establish reporting, controls and escalation procedures, and resolve recurring operational issues.
• Drive automation and process improvements that enable the program to scale efficiently.
• Maintain visibility into program performance, risks and action plans.
 Team Leadership and Claims Oversight
 • Manage and develop the internal claims team, including workload allocation, coaching, performance management and quality assurance.
• Oversee the claims journey from submission through decision and payment of approved claims, in coordination with insurers and claims partners.
• Establish and monitor service levels, ensuring timely customer communication and payment.
• Resolve overdue claims and complex escalations, holding partners accountable for agreed commitments.
• Ensure claims are handled accurately and consistently with applicable coverage terms.
 Customer Retention
 • Own Shield retention performance and lead initiatives to reduce churn in partnership with Customer Success.
• Identify cancellation drivers and early signs of dissatisfaction, and translate findings into corrective actions.
• Address retention issues related to pricing, coverage, claims experience and service delivery.
• Distinguish Shield-specific cancellations from broader Guesty churn, and monitor reductions in coverage among existing customers.
 Commercial Partnerships and Program Economics
 • Own ongoing relationships with insurers, claims administrators and other program partners.
• Lead commercial discussions, renewals, performance reviews and escalations, coordinating with Finance and Legal.
• Negotiate improvements to commercial terms, service levels and operating processes.
• Track program revenue, margins and operating costs with Finance, and identify opportunities to improve profitability while maintaining service and coverage quality.
• Manage partner transitions and ensure continuity of service.

 Requirements

 Must
 • Prior experience in the short-term rental (STR) / vacation rental industry, with a strong understanding of property manager operations, guest-related damage and protection needs.
• 5+ years of relevant experience in program management, insurance or protection programs, operations, or a closely related field.
• Proven experience directly managing and developing an operational team.
• Experience managing insurers or insurance partners, including commercial negotiations and service performance.
• Strong understanding of claims workflows, customer service and operational controls.
• Commercial and analytical judgment, with the ability to use data to improve retention, profitability and service quality.
• A track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from planning through implementation.
• Strong communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work across markets and time zones and take ownership in a fast-moving environment.
 Preferred Qualifications
 • Experience in embedded insurance or property protection programs.
• Experience managing international programs and partner relationships.
• Experience implementing workflow automation, operational dashboards or claims management systems.

title: Director of Transformation
description:
The Mossbourne Federation seeks to appoint a Director of Transformation

Mossbourne Federation is the realisation of Sir Clive Borne’s dream to provide the children of Hackney with an outstanding education. Built on a formula of high expectations, doing the simple things right, and the belief that all children can succeed, Mossbourne offers an environment where all learners, regardless of ability, benefit from innovative and enlightened approaches to teaching and learning. Our calm working atmosphere creates well-rounded individuals who excel in the arts, on the sporting field, and academically.

Since the federation was formed in 2004, we are delighted to have expanded to include three Thurrock schools. We now consist of seven academies:

  • Mossbourne Community Academy (MCA) secondary and sixth form, Hackney

  • Mossbourne Fobbing Academy (MFA) secondary and sixth form, Thurrock

  • Mossbourne Herd Lane Academy (MHLA) primary, Thurrock

  • Mossbourne Parkside Academy (MPA) primary, Hackney

  • Mossbourne Port Side Academy (MPSA) secondary, Thurrock

  • Mossbourne Riverside Academy (MRA) primary, Hackney

  • Mossbourne Victoria Park Academy (MVPA) secondary, Hackney

The role will provide short-term transformation capacity to assess, design, implement and embed a single, evidence-led system of executive educational assurance and accountability, centred on Team Around an Academy (TAA). The ultimate purpose is to ensure every Mossbournian thrives through exceptional educational provision, with outstanding pupil outcomes at the heart of all activity.

The postholder will establish clear executive responsibilities, reliable data, standardised reporting and verifiable follow-through, and contribute to testing and embedding a revised Scheme of Delegation. The work must align with the Academy Trust Handbook 2026, the DfE Academy Trust Governance Guide and Mossbourne’s governing documents. The Federation’s Head of Governance retains responsibility for independent governance advice, the formal governance framework and board approval processes and the Executive Principal, Education Operations remains focused on delivery of other operational improvement programmes to support the Federation’s strategy.

Working for a Mossbourne Federation Academy means being part of a community of exceptional practitioners. Colleagues are warm, welcoming, and supportive of each other. As one of the country’s leading federations, staff expectations are high. The Mossbourne Federation engages with, and supports its workforce, thus creating an inspirational working environment which nurtures the development of personal and professional excellence.

Federation staff are rewarded through the comprehensive package of benefits listed in our Federation Recruitment Brochure, including:

Private healthcare, to support health and wellbeing, fully paid by the Federation

Early finish on Friday - secondary academies

title: Head of Year (Non Teaching)
description:
Dear Candidate,

Thank you very much for your interest in becoming a Head of Year at Manchester Communication Academy. Manchester Communication Academy was first established in 2010 and has gone from strength to strength each academic year. The Academy has approximately 1300 students on roll in Years 7-11 and we boast a wonderfully rich and diverse school community. MCA is at the heart of the community and is committed to improving educational outcomes for all of our students. MCA is proud to be a community hub and our outward facing work is outstanding.

Our non-teaching Heads of Year lead the day-to-day pastoral care, conduct and standards of their year group. Working with the Teaching Director, Pastoral Programme Lead and specialist teams, they combine high expectations with practical support so that every pupil is known, valued and able to learn.

At MCA, we strive for excellence in everything we do. Implementing an ambitious, text-rich curriculum is a key priority and driving force in our ambition for excellence. We believe in the transformative power of knowledge in ensuring equitable opportunities for success. Our aspirational, bespoke curriculum ensures that all of our students gain the necessary experiences to compete academically, practically, socially and morally in the wider world. In order to achieve this, we invest deliberately in professional development. Drawing upon our EEF Research School, we are able to provide all staff with the most up-to-date and high quality evidence to develop their expertise.

At MCA, we proactively promote staff wellbeing through our management of workload and additional benefits for staff, such as flexi days and the Employee Assist programme. As a result, our staff are highly skilled and knowledgeable professionals who embrace new opportunities to learn more and keep getting better - a culture that permeates the academy amongst staff and students.

Our developments now focus on evolving the student experience and their sense of identity and belonging at MCA. We are continuing to develop student culture through a behaviour curriculum for staff and students where expectations and routines are explicitly taught and deliberately practised. Our students appreciate and relish the opportunity to learn and we support their effective learning behaviours through high expectations with emphasis on metacognition and our work with parents, families and the community. Having the highest expectations of our students means that our teachers can focus on teaching and our students can focus on learning. There needs to be relentless consistency with the implementation of the behaviour approach in every classroom, but this needs to be delivered with respect, to help drive the standards we are striving to achieve.

We are now looking for staff who are aligned with our values and will accelerate the school’s journey to excellence. The position is a great opportunity for someone who shares our passion for delivering educational excellence. The right candidate will be able to engage our young people and work effectively with our parents. You will work with authenticity, clarity and empathy and place the wellbeing of students at the core of all decisions.

If you are aligned to our mission and values, and could flourish with this opportunity, we very much look forward to hearing from you. We fully recommend that you take the opportunity to make an informal visit prior to making your application to see the school for yourself.

Kind Regards

Susan Watmough

Headteacher

description:
About the Role

Leeds City College are recruiting for a Data & Performance Officer in the Quality of Education team.

In this role, you will manage the full data lifecycle, from initial collection and preparation through to analysis and interpretation. You will develop and maintain dashboards, monitor key trends, and communicate meaningful, actionable insights to stakeholders, ensuring the highest standards of data accuracy, governance, and GDPR compliance.

You will also serve as the primary point of contact for data-related enquiries, provide tailored systems training to enhance staff knowledge and confidence, and undertake essential administrative responsibilities to support the smooth running of the department.

  • Work with stakeholders to understand their information needs and define appropriate reporting requirements.

  • Examine datasets to identify trends, patterns, and emerging insights that support informed decision-making.

  • Interpret and communicate analytical findings to colleagues and stakeholders, presenting complex information in a easy to understand format to aid evidence-based decisions.

  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost integrity, conducting regular data quality checks and ensuring full compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection standards.

  • Participate in the evaluation and review of data projects, identifying key learnings and opportunities to improve future processes and initiatives.

About You

  • Level 2 qualifications in English and Maths (Grade A–C or equivalent), alongside a relevant Level 3 or Level 4 qualification applicable to the role.

  • Practical experience using business or education software, including intermediate/advanced Excel (formulas and pivot tables), Google Workspace and management information systems such as ProSolution, ProAchieve or OneFile, with the ability to analyse data, identify trends and recommend improvements.

  • Proven ability to build effective, working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels.

  • Strong IT, numerical and data management skills, with excellent attention to detail, a professional and confidential approach to handling information, and the ability to communicate complex data clearly to a range of audiences.

  • Excellent interpersonal, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to use initiative and a proactive, solution-focused approach to enhance service delivery.
