title: Competitive Intelligence Strategist
description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Senior Manager, Competitive Intelligence

Compensation Range: £70,000 to £80,000 base plus bonus and equity

Location: Remote UK

What You’ll Do:

Huntress helps protect organizations from cyber threats with a security platform backed by human expertise. The Competitive & Market Intelligence team helps the business understand how buyers make decisions, how competitors and market conditions are changing, and what those changes mean for Huntress.

As the Senior Competitive & Market Intelligence Strategist, you’ll develop deep insight into European buyers, markets, and competitive dynamics while contributing to global CI and MI priorities. You’ll lead research that informs decisions across regions and turn it into practical guidance for Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Marketing, Pricing, and leadership. The role combines strategic research with field engagement, including deal reviews and support for teams across Huntress.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead Europe-focused market and competitive research while contributing to global CMI priorities. Analyze buyer priorities, category and channel dynamics, competitor positioning, pricing and packaging, and differences across regions.
  • Design and conduct primary and secondary research, including buyer, customer, and partner conversations; win/loss research; competitor analysis; review and community research; and quantitative analysis. Triangulate evidence rather than relying on a single source.
  • Investigate market requirements and differences across regions, with particular depth in European cybersecurity frameworks, regulation, data residency, sovereignty, procurement, and cross-border data access. Build working knowledge of these topics; deep regulatory expertise is not a prerequisite.
  • Support Sales and Sales Engineering with timely competitive guidance across the global field, with Europe as the primary regional focus. Join relevant deal reviews, support active opportunities, and establish recurring CI office hours and team learning sessions. Build practical discovery questions, objection handling, talk tracks, and competitive content sellers can use.
  • Analyze wins, losses, and delayed purchases across regions using buyer interviews and internal evidence, including Salesforce, Gong, and Clozd; while also conduction your own interviews and surveys to distinguish buyer-validated findings from seller-entered data, signals, and inference.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to establish and evolve competitive positioning strategy and messaging, grounded in buyer and market evidence. Turn that strategy into battlecards, competitor comparisons, campaign input, market landscapes, and recommendations for global Sales, Product, Marketing, Pricing, and leadership teams.
  • Partner with global Marketing, PR, and analyst-relations stakeholders on evidence-backed market and competitive context, including media or spokesperson support when appropriate. Use AI tools to accelerate research synthesis and repeatable analysis workflows while validating outputs, protecting sensitive information, and keeping evidence traceable.
  • Work closely with product to share win, loss, and churn reasons, and perform market research that influences and informs the product road maps to overcome competitive pressure and differentiate Huntress from the competition.

What You Bring To The Team:

  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with a background in competitive or market intelligence, market research, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or a customer-facing sales role who is research-minded in cybersecurity. One who is detail-oriented and curious is a strong fit.
  • Technical familiarity with cybersecurity products and the ability to engage credibly with technical buyers, sellers, and product teams. Solutions or Sales Engineering experience is a strong fit, but a prior CI title is not required.
  • Experience designing and conducting qualitative and quantitative research, analyzing buyer or market evidence, and turning findings into defensible recommendations.
  • Experience researching European markets, or a track record of adapting research to meaningful differences across countries, buyer contexts, and routes to market.
  • The judgment to assess source quality, separate fact from interpretation, and explain what the evidence does and does not support.
  • A track record of translating complex research into concise, useful outputs and presenting findings to commercial, product, marketing, and senior audiences.
  • Experience supporting PR or analyst relations, or serving as a spokesperson, is a plus—not a requirement. Familiarity with relevant European frameworks or regulations is also helpful, not required.

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
  • New starter home office set up reimbursement (£398)
  • Generous personal leave entitlements
  • Digital monthly reimbursement (£92)
  • Travel to the US 1-2 times/year for various company events
  • Pension
  • Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes.

Accommodations:

If you require reasonable accommodation to complete this application, interview, or pre-employment testing or participate in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to accommodations@huntresslabs.com. Please note that non-accommodation requests to this inbox will not receive a response.

Huntress uses artificial intelligence tools to assist in reviewing and evaluating job applications, including resume screening, skills assessment, and candidate matching and comparisons. These AI tools support our human recruiters in the initial review process, but do not make final hiring decisions without human involvement. By submitting your application, you acknowledge this use of AI in our recruitment process. Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice for more details on our practices and your data privacy rights.

 Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

 At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

 Join us in transforming the life sciences industry , committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

 The Role

 Are you looking for a place where your work makes an impact? We are seeking a talented Cloud CRM Consultant to join our amazing, fast-paced team of experts in Hungary.

 The Senior Cloud CRM Consultant is a member of our Commercial Managed Services team who provides ongoing professional service for customers live with Veeva’s commercial solutions.

 You will provide application consulting and serve as the strategic bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring systems are scalable, secure, and built to drive business value primarily on the Vault CRM application, but will potentially develop expertise across other Commercial products. You will identify customer requirements, perform configuration changes to the system, activate new product features and act as an advising partner.

 This is a remote, full-time role with Veeva. Candidates must be legally authorised to be employed in Europe. Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status for this employment position. There may be travel opportunities at select times of the year for internal events.

 What You'll Do

• Translates complex business needs into overarching technical designs

• Proactively drive customers towards Veeva and industry best practices

• Understand complex business processes and translate them into technical requirements

• Perform system configuration changes and data migrations

• Activate new product features and ensure seamless integration

• Troubleshoot system issues and provide timely solutions

• Collaborate with internal and external teams to ensure client satisfaction

• Excellent organisational and multitasking skills

• Strong desire to continuously learn and develop

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

• Ability to work independently

 Nice to Have

• Experience working in the Life-Sciences industry

• Experience with Veeva commercial portfolio

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

 Compensation

Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

description:
Windsor Forest Colleges group is looking for a Student Health and Medical Support Lead to join our Safeguarding and Wellbeing team on a full-time, permanent basis over 41 Term Time Only weeks.

Strategically, the post-holder leads health policy compliance by aligning procedures with Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), the SEND Code of Practice, and the Equality Act 2010, while managing health-related safeguarding concerns and multi-agency partnerships with external NHS services. A primary mandate is staff development, where the Lead designs and delivers practical training on procedures such as insulin and buccal anti-convulsant administration, evaluating and signing off on individual staff competence. Essential qualifications include a recognised clinical or allied health qualification and First Aid at Work certification, with professional registration (NMC or HCPC) alongside Mental Health First Aid.

description:
Residential Accommodation Services Manager

Wiltshire College & University Centre – Lackham Campus

Be part of something special. Create a place where students feel at home, build confidence and thrive.

Wiltshire College & University Centre is looking for an enthusiastic, experienced and student-focused Residential Accommodation Services Manager to lead our residential provision at Lackham Campus.

This is an excellent opportunity to take the lead in creating an outstanding residential experience for students, ensuring that those living away from home feel safe, supported, included and part of a vibrant college community. You'll be at the heart of campus life, making a real difference to students' wellbeing, independence, personal development and success.

Set within 500 acres of beautiful Wiltshire countryside, Lackham Campus offers a truly unique learning environment. With a commercial farm, Agri-Tech Centre, Animal Centre, engineering workshops and dedicated horticulture areas, our campus is a thriving, practical and industry-focused environment where learners work with real-world land-based systems and emerging technologies.

As Residential Accommodation Services Manager, you'll have the opportunity to shape the residential experience, lead a dedicated team and work alongside colleagues across the college to create a safe, welcoming and supportive home-from-home environment. You'll also play a vital role in ensuring our provision for under-18s meets the relevant Care Standards and the highest expectations of safeguarding and student welfare.

🌟 What We Offer

💷 Salary: £36,955 per year⏱️ Contract Type: Permanent, Full-Time 37 hours per week, 52 weeks per year📍 Campus: Lackham Campus


A fantastic opportunity to combine leadership, student wellbeing and operational management in a unique college environment where no two days are the same.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and inspire the residential team, creating a positive, professional and student-focused service.
  • Oversee the day-to-day management of residential accommodation, ensuring high standards across all aspects of provision.
  • Create a welcoming and inclusive residential community where students feel safe, valued and supported.
  • Understand and ensure residential services for under-18s meet the relevant Care Standards, maintaining appropriate policies, procedures and quality assurance arrangements.
  • Take responsibility for student welfare, safeguarding and pastoral care, ensuring concerns are identified and managed effectively.
  • Develop opportunities for residential activities and enrichment that encourage friendships, independence and personal development.
  • Work closely with curriculum, safeguarding and student support teams to provide joined-up support.

  • Ensure accommodation meets required standards for health and safety, security, cleanliness and maintenance.
  • Manage staffing, budgets and resources effectively, ensuring an efficient and high-quality service.
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with college policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead, motivate and develop the residential team, driving high standards and continuous improvement.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience managing residential accommodation, student services, pastoral support or a similar service.
  • Proven experience of leading, motivating and developing a team.
  • A strong understanding of safeguarding, student welfare and pastoral care, particularly for under-18s.
  • Knowledge of the Care Standards and regulatory requirements relating to residential provision for young people.
  • Experience of health and safety, risk management and maintaining safe environments.
  • The confidence to manage challenging situations, make sound decisions and resolve issues effectively.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Experience managing budgets, staffing and operational resources.
  • A positive, proactive and solutions-focused approach.
  • A genuine passion for supporting young people to develop independence, confidence and life skills.
  • The ability to inspire a team and create a culture where high standards, care and accountability go hand in hand.

✨ Why Choose This Path?

This is more than an accommodation management role. It's an opportunity to shape an important part of student life and make a lasting difference to young people.

Join us and enjoy the opportunity to:

  • Lead and develop a residential service that plays a vital role in the student experience.
  • Make a meaningful difference to young people's confidence, independence and wellbeing.
  • Build a positive residential community where students feel they belong.
  • Work alongside passionate colleagues in a unique 500-acre specialist campus environment.
  • Influence the quality, development and future direction of residential provision.
  • Make a visible difference every day, knowing that the environment you create helps students succeed.

⚡ Make a Move That Truly Matters

If you're a passionate residential or student support professional with the leadership skills, energy and enthusiasm to make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

This is your opportunity to bring people together, inspire a team and create a residential experience that students will remember for all the right reasons.

🚀 Help us make Lackham more than a place to study. Make it a place where students feel at home, discover their potential and thrive.

The safeguarding and inclusion officer will line manage the welfare officer who runs the medical room, this includes overseeing the main duties and responsibilities of that role. Outstanding outcomes provide our students with the opportunity to continue their studies at prestigious institutions; students at Highlands regularly receive offers from medical schools, Oxbridge and Russell Group universities. Are you passionate about technology and looking to develop your career in IT? Do you enjoy solving problems, helping people and learning new skills?

title: Inclusion and Attendance Officer
description:
Make a difference to attendance, inclusion and belonging


Are you passionate about helping children and young people overcome barriers to education? Do you believe that every pupil deserves the opportunity to attend, engage and thrive in school?

Co-op Academies Trust is looking for a committed and enthusiastic Inclusion and Attendance Officer to join our West Yorkshire team.

This is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful difference to the lives of pupils and families by promoting positive attendance, strengthening inclusion and supporting those who face challenges in accessing education.

Working across a cluster of our academies, you will build positive relationships with pupils, families, school colleagues and external agencies to identify barriers to attendance and engagement, provide early intervention and help pupils feel supported, included and connected to school.


About the role

As an Inclusion and Attendance Officer, you will play a key role in improving attendance and supporting pupils who may be vulnerable, disadvantaged or at risk of disengaging from education.

Working closely with attendance, safeguarding, pastoral and SEND teams, you will provide targeted support to pupils and families, helping to develop practical solutions that improve attendance, engagement and educational outcomes.

Your responsibilities will include:

  1. Identifying patterns of absence and barriers to inclusion, using attendance information to inform targeted support.
  2. Building positive and trusting relationships with pupils and families through regular engagement, home visits and early intervention.
  3. Planning, delivering and reviewing individualised attendance and inclusion interventions.
  4. Working collaboratively with school colleagues and external agencies to coordinate effective support for pupils and families.
  5. Supporting pupils experiencing emotionally based barriers to school attendance and other challenges affecting engagement.
  6. Contributing to reintegration and transition arrangements for pupils returning from extended absence.
  7. Maintaining accurate and confidential records of interventions, progress and outcomes.
  8. Supporting school attendance procedures and statutory processes where appropriate.


About you

We are looking for someone who is approachable, resilient, organised and passionate about improving outcomes for children and young people.

You will have:

  1. Experience of working with children, young people and families, particularly those experiencing challenging circumstances.
  2. An understanding of the barriers that can affect school attendance, inclusion and engagement.
  3. Experience of effective partnership working with external agencies to support pupils and families.
  4. Experience of maintaining accurate records, documenting interventions and monitoring outcomes.
  5. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build positive relationships and engage families sensitively.
  6. An understanding of safeguarding responsibilities and the importance of early intervention.
  7. The ability to manage your own workload, work independently and contribute effectively as part of a wider team.
  8. Good organisational and ICT skills.

Experience of supporting pupils with SEND or social, emotional and mental health needs would be advantageous.

As the role involves travelling between academies and undertaking home visits, a full driving licence and access to a vehicle for business use are required.


Why join the Co-op Academies Trust?


At Co-op Academies Trust, we are committed to creating inclusive school communities where every child feels valued, supported and able to succeed.


You will be joining a collaborative team that recognises the importance of strong relationships, early intervention and working together to remove barriers to education.

This is an opportunity to contribute to a Trust-wide approach to improving attendance and inclusion, while making a tangible difference to the experiences and outcomes of pupils and their families.

How to apply

If you are passionate about inclusion, committed to improving attendance and motivated by making a difference, we would love to hear from you. Please follow the online application process to be considered. 

Co-op Academies Trust is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. The successful candidate will be required to undertake an enhanced DBS check and comply with the Trust's safeguarding policies and procedures.

Fixed Term Contract

January 2027 - August 2027

We are delighted to offer an opportunity for an enthusiastic and inspiring Teacher of Science to join our highly successful Science Department on a fixed-term basis from January 2027 until August 2027.

At Pittville School, we are proud of our inclusive ethos and commitment to ensuring every student achieves their potential. We place staff wellbeing and professional development at the heart of our work and have developed a genuinely supportive environment in which colleagues can thrive.

Whilst this appointment is initially fixed-term, the school anticipates completing curriculum modelling and staffing reviews during the academic year and therefore welcomes applications from candidates seeking to make a significant contribution to the department during this period.

We are looking for someone who shares our high expectations, enthusiasm for teaching and commitment to helping young people succeed.

At Key Stage 3, students follow a carefully sequenced curriculum designed to develop scientific knowledge, curiosity and practical skills. While the ability to teach Biology as a specialism is desirable, applications from teachers of all science specialisms are warmly welcomed.

As a school, we are committed to investing in our staff. All new colleagues benefit from a comprehensive induction programme, high-quality professional development and access to a range of opportunities through our wider professional networks. This sits alongside a strong programme of internal training, collaborative practice and professional learning.

title: Teacher of Alternative Provision within Nurture and Strive
description:
TEACHER OF ALTERNATIVE PROVISION WITHIN NURTURE AND STRIVE

Salary: MPS/UPS.

Contract: Permanent. Full Time

Start date: January 2027 or sooner

Place of work: St Peters School, Huntingdon

Place of work:

Teaching is the most rewarding job in the world. We have the opportunity to change students’ lives for the better and you could make a positive impact at St Peter’s School.  

We are a forward thinking and rapidly improving, “good” school that is creating a legacy of learning for our community. Our students Learn, Aspire and Exceed as they work with our highly skilled teaching and associate staff supporting and guiding them. 

St Peter’s is part of The Cam Academy Trust which offers students and staff fantastic potential to collaborate, share and develop a wide range of teaching and learning across the schools in the trust. As a family of schools, we support, share and challenge each other to improve the future lives of all our young people. 

St Peter’s inclusion provision has a good reputation within The Cam Academy Trust and the local area. Our inclusion offer includes our KS3 Nurture provision and STRIVE, our internal alternative provision. This role sits across both.

Our KS3 Nurture provision has been established for 10 years. The Nurture department consists of 5 dedicated teachers leading the curriculum with experience in developing numeracy and literacy. There is a tailored curriculum based on improving students’ basic skills to an age-appropriate level so that they can successfully integrate into secondary school life. The Nurture teachers utilise a wide range of teaching strategies, using an adapted primary model, to improve engagement with education for the students. Class sizes are capped at 17 at a maximum but on average consist of 14 students or fewer.

STRIVE is our internal alternative provision for students in Years 8-11 who display challenging behaviour and are unable to be successful in mainstream education; some students also have SEND needs or an EHCP. Students study English, Maths, Science and Humanities, with those in Years 10 and 11 working towards GCSE qualifications, alongside an enrichment programme that includes AQA Unit Award Scheme certificates. STRIVE takes a broadly restorative approach built on its ethos of Support, Trust, Respect, Invest, Value and Educate, with clear routines, consistent expectations and positive relationships at its heart. Where appropriate, students are supported to reintegrate into mainstream lessons.

The suitable candidate will either be:

an experienced practitioner with SEND or primary experience

an ECT with an in interest in SEND, numeracy and literacy

St Peter’s prides itself in the professional development available to staff, we have had a number of staff complete a wide range of courses including: NPQML, and training with exam board providers as well as in house training. 

We are based in Huntingdon, just 12 miles north of Cambridge with its own mainline station connecting with London in less than an hour. 

For the right candidate, we are able to offer the opportunity to teach lessons across the age and ability range of our students.

For further details on our school please visit our website Home - St Peter's School.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Global Monetization Product and Technology
description:
Responsibilities

The HRBP Global Monetization Product and Technology team partners with leaders across the product, operations, and engineering organizations behind the company's global advertising business. We translate business and technology priorities into people and organizational strategies, shaping workforce plans, organizational design, talent development, performance, and employee engagement.

We work across teams building complex monetization products and infrastructure for different markets, customer needs, and stages of growth. This requires us to understand both technical and commercial priorities, anticipate emerging capability needs, and develop people strategies that connect specialized disciplines across regions. By combining organizational insight with business data and engagement insights, we help teams scale while strengthening leadership and collaboration.

You will build trusted partnerships with leaders and collaborate across HR functions to guide important organization and talent decisions. Your work may span organizational development, workforce and succession planning, leadership development, performance, incentives, culture, and engagement. By staying close to the organization as strategies are implemented, you can see how people decisions shape the teams building global monetization products and technology, and use those insights to strengthen what comes next.

About the Team:
The Global Monetization Product & Technology (GMPT) team powers TikTok's revenue ecosystem. We build the advanced advertising technologies and platforms that enable brands and businesses to connect with audiences worldwide. Our scope spans backend targeting signals, ad measurement infrastructure, and creative tools for advertisers across Brand, SMB, and Performance channels.

As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you will play a key role in scaling this high-impact organization by hiring world-class Product, Design, Data, and Technical talent. This role demands strategic partnership, operational excellence, and a data-driven mindset to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Specifically, you will:
- Full-Cycle Recruitment: Lead and manage end-to-end hiring for 10-15+ roles, primarily across Product Management, Product Design, Product Marketing, and Data Science.
- Strategic Partnering: Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and business leaders to define hiring needs, advise on market insights, and develop effective recruitment strategies.
- Data-Driven Sourcing: Use data and insights to design sourcing strategies that attract, engage, and convert top-tier technical and product talent globally.
- Market Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert on talent market trends, compensation benchmarks, and competitor insights to help inform hiring decisions and workforce planning.
- Operational Excellence: Maintain a high bar for candidate experience, process efficiency, and compliance across all recruiting activities.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with HRBPs, Compensation, and Global TA peers to ensure consistent hiring practices and alignment across regions.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- 3+ years of full-lifecycle recruiting experience, ideally within high-growth tech or global organizations.
- Proven success hiring across Product Management and/or Product Marketing functions, with additional exposure to technical and data roles.
- Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and advise.
- Comfortable managing a dynamic requisition load (10-15+) and thriving in an environment of constant evolution and growth.
- Data-driven mindset with experience leveraging recruiting metrics and analytics to drive outcomes and influence decisions.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience supporting global or cross-regional recruiting efforts, with flexibility to collaborate across time zones.
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Excel) to generate reports and insights.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior leadership and cross-functional partners.
- Passion for innovation and curiosity about how technology, data, and creativity intersect to drive impact at scale.

title: Backend Software Engineer - Data Connectors
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.
 
The Role
 
The Connectivity team builds the software that connects Palantir’s platform to customer systems. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real-time events and user-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP.
 
You’ll build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software.
 
A central part of this work is evolving and scaling a large, established codebase. You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share.

title: Dealer Development Manager (Portland, OR)
description:
Headquarters: United States (Remote)

 Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

 We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

 We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

 About the Role:

 The Dealer Development Manager will represent Upgrade Inc (Auto Finance Division) and promote our indirect lending programs. They will develop, maintain, and grow business partnerships between Upgrade Inc. and our dealership partners. The Dealer Development Manager is also responsible for staying up-to-date on local market conditions and industry trends. In this role, you will work with internal partners to find solutions that better serve our customers, and build long lasting relationships with key decision makers to drive growth and continuous improvement. This position requires residency in the greater Portland area.

 What You’ll Do:

 Dealer Relationship Management

• Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing dealer partners

• Act as a trusted advisor to dealership owners, GMs, and F&I managers

• Conduct regular in-person dealership visits based on a structured drive schedule

• Deliver consistent follow-up and service to ensure dealer satisfaction and loyalty

 Dealer Acquisition & Activation

• Identify, onboard, and activate new dealer partners

• Drive dealer sign-ups and first deals (“activation”)

• Re-engage inactive dealers (e.g., no deals in 90 days) and return them to production

• Execute onboarding training to ensure dealers understand programs and systems

 Production & Volume Growth

• Achieve monthly funding and application volume goals

• Increase contracts per active dealer and overall territory production

• Focus on growing volume in Tier 3–5 segments while maintaining quality

• Drive penetration targets (e.g., 3+ and 5+ deals per dealer per month)

 Credit & Deal Structuring

• Partner closely with underwriting/credit teams to structure deals effectively

• Educate dealers on program guidelines, stips, and deal packaging

• Improve pull-through by coaching dealers on submitting clean, fundable deals

 Portfolio Performance & Quality

• Monitor dealer portfolio performance (delinquency, charge-offs, profitability)

• Manage dealer mix to align with company risk appetite and profitability goals

• Shift focus toward preferred collateral and higher-performing dealers

• Ensure adherence to compliance, credit policies, and documentation standards

 Training & Dealer Development

• Conduct ongoing product and process training with dealership staff

• Educate dealers on value-added products

• Provide market insights and best practices to improve dealer success

• Position the company as a relationship-driven partner vs. transactional lender

 Territory & Activity Management

• Maintain a disciplined weekly drive schedule maximizing in-person dealer time

• Track and manage activity through CRM (e.g., Salesforce)

• Analyze territory performance and adjust strategy based on data

• Participate in team calls, sales meetings, and performance reviews

 What We Look For:

• 2+ years of experience in indirect auto finance, auto sales, or related field

• Strong understanding of credit tiers, loan structuring, and dealership operations

• Proven ability to build relationships and drive sales growth

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills

• Self-motivated with strong time management and territory planning skills

• Ability to travel locally (significant field time required)

 What We Offer You:

• Competitive salary, uncapped commission and stock option plan

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

• Flexible PTO

• Competitive 401(k)

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

• Paid parental leave

• Health & wellness initiatives

 #LI-Hybrid

 For California residents: Upgrade's California Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy describes our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of the personal information of job applicants.

 Environmental & Working Conditions

 Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.

 Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.

 The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.

 Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

 THE OPPORTUNITY:

 At Salesloft, our People Operations Coordinator is foundational to a high-performing People team. Each coordinator embeds with their assigned business function(s) (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Sales) to provide full employee lifecycle support, from offer through exit. As the first point of contact for employees and managers, coordinators deliver high-volume, high-accuracy service across HR transactions, data, leave, employee relations support, and employee questions, creating a consistently excellent employee experience. They partner closely with People Business Partners, keeping the work moving, the data clean, and the PBP fully informed, and work alongside Total Rewards, Benefits and Mobility, and Talent Acquisition so programs run smoothly.

 Each coordinator also serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing local compliance knowledge, language, and time zone coverage to the team. Working within a shared services model, coordinators cover for one another across functions during peak periods and absences, and bring back improvements that strengthen the whole team. This is a broad, high-visibility role and a clear path toward People Business Partner or People Operations leadership.

 About 60 - 70% of your time supports your assigned business function(s) and their People Business Partner. That includes lifecycle transactions, employee data, questions, ER support, and the people programs for your pod.

 The remaining 30–40% supports the broader People team. You will help Total Rewards with compensation and benefits cycles, partner with People Systems on HiBob, data, and reporting, and support Talent Acquisition through the handoff from offer to onboarding. You’ll also serve as the expert for your assigned country and cover for teammates during peak periods.

 The balance shifts with the business calendar. Expect more Total Rewards work during open enrollment and compensation cycles, for example. We review it regularly throughout the year.

 This role begins as a three-month contract with the opportunity to convert to a full-time, permanent Salesloft position based on business needs and performance. The contract period gives you the chance to learn the team, the systems and the business function you support, and gives us the chance to work together before making a long-term commitment. We will check in with you along the way so you know how things are going.

 On a day-to-day basis, you will:

• Lifecycle Administration. Manages the employee lifecycle for the assigned business function, from offer through exit. Prepares offer letters, coordinates background checks and I-9 and right-to-work verification, and runs onboarding and offboarding, including exit surveys, so every transition is accurate and on time.

• Employee Data & Records. Maintains accurate employee data in HiBob and ADP for the assigned business function. Processes hires, changes, promotions, transfers, terminations, and org updates, and audits records and personnel files to keep data clean and audit-ready.

• HR Case Management. Serves as the first point of contact for employee and manager questions through people@ and HappyFox. Resolves routine requests promptly and escalates complex or sensitive issues to People Business Partners and specialists.

• Mobility, & Benefits Support. Serves as the first point of contact for benefits questions and partners closely with the Benefits and Mobility Specialist to keep PBPs informed on mobility cases.

• PBP, ER & Programs Support.

• PBP Partnership & Employee Relations Support. Partners with the assigned People Business Partner through weekly syncs, sharing context so they have full visibility without having to ask. Supports ER cases under PBP direction by maintaining documentation and the ER tracker, coordinating investigation logistics, and preparing PIP and termination paperwork.

• Program administration: Project manages the promotion process for the assigned business function, tracking and documenting each promotion through processing. Supports compensation cycle execution and submits roles for compensation analysis, following up with leaders and tracking turnaround.

• Survey, QBR & Talent Support. Manages the engagement survey in the system and compiles data and pre-reads for leadership reviews. Supports the QBR process and prepares data and insights for talent calibration conversations.

• Reporting, Analytics & Compliance Support. Fulfills data requests and runs standard reports and headcount reconciliations, providing analysis that supports business reviews and People programs. Supports audits, country-specific filings, I-9 compliance, record retention, and policy acknowledgments, and manages vendor invoices.

• Process Improvement. Establishes and maintains SOPs so the team delivers consistent service across pods. Flags recurring case themes and tests HRIS and workflow changes, turning patterns from the assigned business function into improvements for the whole team.

• Country Expertise. Serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing knowledge of local employment practices and compliance requirements, along with language and time zone coverage. Reviews country-specific documents prepared by other coordinators, supports local filings and vendor relationships, and keeps the team current on changes in local requirements.

 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 We are looking for a service-minded, detail-obsessed People professional who takes pride in getting the work right the first time. You understand that every offer letter, record update, and employee question is someone’s experience of the company, and you treat each one that way. You are comfortable being the first point of contact for employees and managers, and you know when to resolve a request yourself and when to bring in a People Business Partner or specialist. You handle confidential information with discretion and communicate clearly in writing. You are equally at home working through a high volume of transactions and spotting the pattern behind them, and you bring ideas back that make the whole team better. You enjoy partnering with business leaders, adapt easily across time zones and cultures, and want to build toward a career as a People Business Partner or in People Operations leadership.

 THE TEAM:

 Our People Operations Coordinators, PBPs and specialists work as one team on a shared goal, and each role has clear ownership. Coordinators are the front door of the People organization: warm, responsive and exact, with the pride in getting it right that earns managers’ and employees’ trust. We are a global team across India, Mexico and the United States, we cover for one another, and we share what we learn so every pod gets better. At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. title: Senior AI Engineer - EU
description:
Headquarters: Germany (Remote) ; Ireland (Remote); Netherlands (Remote) ; Portugal (Remote) ; Spain (Remote) ; United Kingdom (Remote)

 Who we are

 Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

 Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal, Spain or The Netherlands

 About the team

 The AI Engineering team builds the systems and capabilities behind Typeform’s AI products, including Research Flow, our platform for combining quantitative research with deeper qualitative insights.

 We use machine learning, large language models, RAG, and agentic systems to help customers collect, understand, and act on information in more conversational and personalised ways.

 Through Research Flow, this includes helping customers design studies, run AI-moderated conversations with adaptive follow-up questions, and turn responses into useful insights.

 The team owns the journey from experimentation through to production. This includes AI application development, evaluation, infrastructure, deployment, observability, reliability, and performance.

 You will work closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analytics teams to turn promising AI ideas into secure, scalable, and dependable customer experiences.

 About the role

 As a Senior AI Engineer at Typeform, you will be instrumental in building and evolving the AI capabilities behind Research Flow, alongside our broader AI products.

 Your work will help customers understand the “why” behind responses and move from research questions to informed decisions faster.

 Your scope will span generative AI applications, enterprise RAG systems, agentic workflows, model evaluation, machine learning pipelines, and the infrastructure required to run them reliably at scale.

 This is a hands-on engineering role with strong ownership. You will turn ideas and prototypes into production systems used by our customers, with direct influence on their quality and performance. You will also help define the technical standards for developing, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring AI across Typeform.

 Things you will do

 Build and deliver AI products

• Design, build, and deploy generative AI capabilities across Typeform’s products, with a key contribution to Research Flow.

• Develop applications using large language models, RAG, vector search, and agentic systems.

• Build services and APIs that allow product teams to integrate AI capabilities into customer experiences.

• Turn prototypes into reliable production systems with clear measures of performance and quality.

• Explore new ways for customers to collect, understand, and act on information using AI.

 Build scalable AI systems

• Design and operate machine learning services and workflows using Python, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS.

• Build reliable pipelines for batch and real time processing using technologies such as Kafka and Airflow.

• Design solutions using vector databases to support retrieval, recommendations, personalisation, and semantic search.

• Use MLflow to manage experiments, model versions, registries, and deployments.

• Improve the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency of our AI systems.

 Evaluate and improve AI quality

• Build automated evaluation pipelines for generative AI applications, including the conversational and analytical capabilities behind Research Flow.

• Develop benchmarks that measure accuracy, relevance, reliability, fairness, latency, and cost.

• Evaluate retrieval strategies, including chunking, embeddings, context selection, and reranking.

• Monitor AI systems in production and identify opportunities to improve their quality and performance.

• Create safeguards that reduce unexpected behaviour and protect customer data.

 Shape our AI engineering practice

• Establish reusable patterns and technical standards for building, evaluating, and releasing AI systems.

• Help teams make informed decisions about models, frameworks, infrastructure, performance, and cost.

• Apply strong engineering practices across testing, security, observability, version control, and deployment.

• Share technical knowledge and support the development of other engineers.

• Keep up with relevant AI research, tools, and engineering practices, applying what is useful to Typeform.

 Collaborate across Typeform

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams to connect AI investments with customer and business needs.

• Work with Data Scientists to turn experiments and models into reliable production services.

• Communicate technical concepts, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and nontechnical partners.

• Contribute to technical planning and help shape the direction of AI across Typeform.

 What you bring

• At least four years of experience building and deploying machine learning or AI systems in production.

• Strong Python and software engineering skills.

• Experience building production services using Python frameworks such as FastAPI.

• Practical experience developing generative AI applications using large language models, RAG, tool use, or agentic systems.

• Experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.

• A strong understanding of enterprise RAG systems, including chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, evaluation, and monitoring.

• Experience creating automated evaluations for generative AI applications.

• Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and continuous integration and deployment practices.

• Experience using services such as AWS SageMaker or AWS Bedrock.

• Experience with Kafka, vector databases, or other technologies used for real time and high dimensional data processing.

• Experience managing machine learning workflows using MLflow.

• Experience monitoring production systems with tools such as Datadog or OpenSearch.

• The ability to balance quality, speed, reliability, scalability, and cost when making technical decisions.

• Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Data teams.

 Extra awesome

• Experience working in a B2B SaaS product company.

• Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Argo Workflows.

• Familiarity with SQL, Spark, Snowflake, or other data processing technologies.

• Experience building systems that combine structured data, unstructured data, and generative AI.

• Experience with AI security, privacy, responsible AI, prompt injection protection, or data leakage prevention.

• Experience improving the latency and cost of AI systems operating at scale.

 *Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team , empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.

 We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.

 Integration Engineers provide leadership, facilitate analysis and design tasks, and support multiple Legion teams in developing an enterprise's solution architecture. Job responsibilities are grouped across four key areas: Technical Integrations, Customer-Centric Consulting, Legion Product Expertise, and a Commitment to One Another.

 Please note this role involves participation in on-call rotation.

 Technical Integrations

• Design, Build, and Test integrations using Workato

• Develop secure and efficient REST APIs within Legion's API-driven ecosystem.

• Ensure high-performance, reliable integrations using modern cloud platforms.

• Engage with architects and engineers for design collaboration and code reviews.

• Improve development practices and stay ahead of agile software engineering trends.

 Legion Product Expertise

• Gain and maintain deep knowledge of Legion's product and integration ecosystem.

• Identify, report, and prioritize product bugs and enhancements.

• Work with core engineering and production engineering teams to improve backend reliability and troubleshoot production issues

• Stay updated on new releases and enhancements to drive product adoption.

• Write secure, enterprise-grade integration code using leading platforms and technologies.

• Write well-designed, testable, efficient code

• Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle

• Conduct peer code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability.

 Team Collaboration & Mentorship

• Share expertise and mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing.

• Contribute to best practices for integration and internal technical documentation.

• Support process improvements and advocate for scalable, sustainable integrations.

• Commit to high-quality work, setting personal and team objectives aligned with organizational goals.

• Standard shift working hours: 0900-1800

• This role involves participation in on-call rotation.

• This role may require work outside of normal business hours.

 REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• Graduate of a university with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant STEM field, including Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant degree

 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 ABOUT LEGION

 Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. title: Senior AI Engineer - US
description:
Headquarters: United States (Remote)

 Who we are

 Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

 Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the ET timezone in the US.

 About the team

 The AI Engineering team builds the systems and capabilities behind Typeform’s AI products, including Research Flow, our platform for combining quantitative research with deeper qualitative insights.

 We use machine learning, large language models, RAG, and agentic systems to help customers collect, understand, and act on information in more conversational and personalised ways.

 Through Research Flow, this includes helping customers design studies, run AI-moderated conversations with adaptive follow-up questions, and turn responses into useful insights.

 The team owns the journey from experimentation through to production. This includes AI application development, evaluation, infrastructure, deployment, observability, reliability, and performance.

 You will work closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analytics teams to turn promising AI ideas into secure, scalable, and dependable customer experiences.

 About the role

 As a Senior AI Engineer at Typeform, you will be instrumental in building and evolving the AI capabilities behind Research Flow, alongside our broader AI products.

 Your work will help customers understand the “why” behind responses and move from research questions to informed decisions faster.

 Your scope will span generative AI applications, enterprise RAG systems, agentic workflows, model evaluation, machine learning pipelines, and the infrastructure required to run them reliably at scale.

 This is a hands-on engineering role with strong ownership. You will turn ideas and prototypes into production systems used by our customers, with direct influence on their quality and performance. You will also help define the technical standards for developing, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring AI across Typeform.

 Things you will do

 Build and deliver AI products

• Design, build, and deploy generative AI capabilities across Typeform’s products, with a key contribution to Research Flow.

• Develop applications using large language models, RAG, vector search, and agentic systems.

• Build services and APIs that allow product teams to integrate AI capabilities into customer experiences.

• Turn prototypes into reliable production systems with clear measures of performance and quality.

• Explore new ways for customers to collect, understand, and act on information using AI.

 Build scalable AI systems

• Design and operate machine learning services and workflows using Python, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS.

• Build reliable pipelines for batch and real time processing using technologies such as Kafka and Airflow.

• Design solutions using vector databases to support retrieval, recommendations, personalisation, and semantic search.

• Use MLflow to manage experiments, model versions, registries, and deployments.

• Improve the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency of our AI systems.

 Evaluate and improve AI quality

• Build automated evaluation pipelines for generative AI applications, including the conversational and analytical capabilities behind Research Flow.

• Develop benchmarks that measure accuracy, relevance, reliability, fairness, latency, and cost.

• Evaluate retrieval strategies, including chunking, embeddings, context selection, and reranking.

• Monitor AI systems in production and identify opportunities to improve their quality and performance.

• Create safeguards that reduce unexpected behaviour and protect customer data.

 Shape our AI engineering practice

• Establish reusable patterns and technical standards for building, evaluating, and releasing AI systems.

• Help teams make informed decisions about models, frameworks, infrastructure, performance, and cost.

• Apply strong engineering practices across testing, security, observability, version control, and deployment.

• Share technical knowledge and support the development of other engineers.

• Keep up with relevant AI research, tools, and engineering practices, applying what is useful to Typeform.

 Collaborate across Typeform

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams to connect AI investments with customer and business needs.

• Work with Data Scientists to turn experiments and models into reliable production services.

• Communicate technical concepts, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and nontechnical partners.

• Contribute to technical planning and help shape the direction of AI across Typeform.

 What you bring

• At least four years of experience building and deploying machine learning or AI systems in production.

• Strong Python and software engineering skills.

• Experience building production services using Python frameworks such as FastAPI.

• Practical experience developing generative AI applications using large language models, RAG, tool use, or agentic systems.

• Experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.

• A strong understanding of enterprise RAG systems, including chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, evaluation, and monitoring.

• Experience creating automated evaluations for generative AI applications.

• Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and continuous integration and deployment practices.

• Experience using services such as AWS SageMaker or AWS Bedrock.

• Experience with Kafka, vector databases, or other technologies used for real time and high dimensional data processing.

• Experience managing machine learning workflows using MLflow.

• Experience monitoring production systems with tools such as Datadog or OpenSearch.

• The ability to balance quality, speed, reliability, scalability, and cost when making technical decisions.

• Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Data teams.

 Extra awesome

• Experience working in a B2B SaaS product company.

• Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Argo Workflows.

• Familiarity with SQL, Spark, Snowflake, or other data processing technologies.

• Experience building systems that combine structured data, unstructured data, and generative AI.

• Experience with AI security, privacy, responsible AI, prompt injection protection, or data leakage prevention.

• Experience improving the latency and cost of AI systems operating at scale.

 *Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team , empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.

 We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/typeform-senior-ai-engineer-us

title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer I - Germany/Austria/UK
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

 Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

 You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

 JOB SUMMARY

 You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it.

 This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation.

 You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team.

 We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room.

 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

 Database platform (approx. 60%)

• Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths.

• Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions.

• Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene.

• Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path.

• Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require.

• Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability.

 Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%)

• Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes.

• Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them.

• Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant.

 Team, incidents, and collaboration

• Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence.

• Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person.

• Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

 EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS

 Required — PostgreSQL depth

• 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL.

• Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning.

• Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services.

• Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables.

• Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies.

 Required — Infrastructure and ways of working

• Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS.

• Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling.

• Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation).

• Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes.

• Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists.

• Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 Nice to have

• Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued).

• Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load.

• Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows.

• Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional).

 MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

 Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

 GENERAL TERMS

 Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here .

 All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ).

 Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor

 If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com
